name: Why did the writer complain to the people behind him?
trans: 为什么作者会向他身后的人抱怨呢？

name: Last week I went to the theatre.
trans: 上周我去看了电影。

name: I had a very good seat.
trans: 我的座位非常好。

name: The play was very interesting.
trans: 这出戏非常有趣。

name: I did not enjoy it.
trans: 我并不喜欢它。

name: A young man and a young woman were sitting behind me.
trans: 一个年轻男子和一个年轻女子坐在我后面。

name: They were talking loudly.
trans: 他们说话的声音很大。

name: I got very angry.
trans: 我非常生气。

name: I could not hear the actors.
trans: 我听不到演员们的声音。

name: I turned round.
trans: 我转过身来。

name: I looked at the man and the woman angrily.
trans: 我愤怒地瞪着那个男人和那个女人。

name: They did not pay any attention.
trans: 他们根本没有理会。

name: In the end, I could not bear it.
trans: 最后，我实在无法忍受下去了。

name: I turned round again.
trans: 我又转过身去。

name: 'I can't hear a word!' I said angrily.
trans: “我一个字都听不见！”我愤怒地说道。

name: 'It's none of your business,'
trans: “这不关你的事。”

name: the young man said rudely.
trans: 那个年轻人粗鲁地说道。

name: 'This is a private conversation!'
trans: “这可是私人谈话！”

name: Why was the writer's aunt surprised?
trans: 为什么作者的阿姨会感到惊讶呢？

name: It was Sunday.
trans: 那是星期天。

name: I never get up early on Sundays.
trans: 我从来不在周日早起。

name: I sometimes stay in bed until lunchtime.
trans: 有时候我会一直躺在床上，直到午餐时间才起床。

name: Last Sunday I got up very late.
trans: 上周日，我起得很晚。

name: I looked out of the window.
trans: 我望向了窗外。

name: It was dark outside.
trans: 外面一片漆黑。

name: 'What a day!' I thought.
trans: “真是美好的一天啊！”我想。

name: 'It's raining again.'
trans: “又下雨了。”

name: Just then, the telephone rang.
trans: 就在这时，电话响了。

name: It was my aunt Lucy.
trans: 那是我的阿姨露西。

name: 'I've just arrived by train,' she said.
trans: “我刚乘火车到达的，”她说。

name: 'I'm coming to see you.'
trans: “我来看你了。”

name: 'But I'm still having breakfast,' I said.
trans: “但我还在吃早餐呢，”我说。

name: 'What are you doing?' she asked.
trans: “你在做什么？”她问。

name: 'I'm having breakfast,' I repeated.
trans: “我在吃早餐，”我重复道。

name: 'Dear me,' she said.
trans: “天哪，”她说。

name: 'Do you always get up so late?
trans: “你总是起这么晚吗？

name: It's one o'clock!'
trans: 现在都一点钟了！”

name: How many cards did the writer send?
trans: 作家寄出了多少张卡片？
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: Postcards always spoil my holidays.
trans: 明信片总是破坏我的假期心情。
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: Last summer, I went to Italy.
trans: 去年夏天，我去了意大利。
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: I visited museums and sat in public gardens.
trans: 我参观了博物馆，还坐在公共花园里休息。
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian.
trans: 一位友好的服务员教了我一些意大利语单词；
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: Then he lent me a book.
trans: 之后他还借给我一本书。
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: I read a few lines, but I did not understand a word.
trans: 我读了几行，但一个字也看不懂。
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: Everyday I thought about postcards.
trans: 每天我都在想着那些明信片……
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: My holidays passed quickly,
trans: 假期很快就过去了，
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: but I did not send cards to my friends.
trans: 但我却没有给朋友们寄任何卡片。
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: On the last day I made a big decision.
trans: 在最后一天，我做出了一个重要的决定：
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: I got up early and bought thirty-seven cards.
trans: 我早早起床，买了三十七张明信片。
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: I spent the whole day in my room,
trans: 我一整天都待在房间里，
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: but I did not write a single card!
trans: 却一张卡片都没写！
lesson: NCE2 · Please Send Me a Card

name: Why is Tim finding this trip exciting?
trans: 为什么蒂姆觉得这次旅行如此令人兴奋呢？

name: I have just received a letter from my brother, Tim.
trans: 我刚刚收到了我哥哥蒂姆的一封信。

name: He is in Australia.
trans: 他在澳大利亚。

name: He has been there for six months.
trans: 他已经在那里待了六个月了。

name: Tim is an engineer.
trans: 蒂姆是一名工程师。

name: He is working for a big firm and he has already visited
trans: 他在一家大公司工作，而且他已经去过那里（即：他已经到那家公司拜访过）。

name: a great number of different places in Australia.
trans: 澳大利亚有许多不同的地方。

name: He has just bought an Australian car and has gone to Alice Springs,
trans: 他刚买了一辆澳大利亚产的汽车，然后去了爱丽丝泉（Alice Springs）。

name: a small town in the centre of Australia.
trans: 澳大利亚中部的一个小镇。

name: He will soon visit Darwin.
trans: 他很快将会去达尔文。

name: From there, he will fly to Perth.
trans: 从那里，他将飞往珀斯。

name: My brother has never been abroad before,
trans: 我哥哥以前从未出过国。

name: so he is finding this trip very exciting.
trans: 所以他觉得这次旅行非常令人兴奋。

name: What does 'No wrong numbers' mean?
trans: “没有错误的数字”是什么意思？

name: Mr.James Scott has a garage in Silbury
trans: 詹姆斯·斯科特先生在塞尔伯里（Silbury）有一间车库。

name: and now he has just bought another garage in Pinhurst.
trans: 现在他又在 Pinhurst 买了一个车库。

name: Pinhurst is only five miles from Silbury,
trans: 平赫斯特（Pinhurst）距离西尔伯里（Silbury）只有五英里。

name: but Mr. Scott cannot get a telephone for his new garage,
trans: 但是斯科特先生无法为他的新车库配备一部电话。

name: so he has just bought twelve pigeons.
trans: 所以他刚刚买了十二只鸽子。

name: Yesterday, a pigeon carried the first message from Pinhurst to Silbury.
trans: 昨天，一只鸽子将第一封来自 Pinhurst 的消息送到了 Silbury。

name: The bird covered the distance in three minutes.
trans: 这只鸟用了三分钟的时间走完了这段距离。

name: Up to now,
trans: 到目前为止，

name: Mr.Scott has sent a great many requests for spare parts
trans: 斯科特先生已经提交了大量的零件请求。

name: and other urgent messages from one garage to the other.
trans: 以及其他紧急信息，从一间车库发送到另一间车库。

name: In this way, he has begun his own private 'telephone' service.
trans: 通过这种方式，他开始了自己的私人“电话”服务。

name: Who is Percy Buttons?
trans: 珀西·巴顿斯（Percy Buttons）是谁？

name: I have just moved to a house in Bridge Street.
trans: 我刚刚搬到了 Bridge Street 上的一栋房子里。

name: Yesterday a beggar knocked at my door.
trans: 昨天，一个乞丐敲了我的门。

name: He asked me for a meal and a glass of beer.
trans: 他请我吃了一顿饭，还喝了一杯啤酒。

name: In return for this,
trans: 作为对此的回报，

name: the beggar stood on his head and sang songs.
trans: 那个乞丐倒立着，同时还在唱歌。

name: I gave him a meal.
trans: 我给他准备了一顿饭。

name: He ate the food and drank the beer.
trans: 他吃了食物，喝了啤酒。

name: Then he put a piece of cheese in his pocket and went away.
trans: 然后他把一块奶酪放进口袋里，就离开了。

name: Later a neighbour told me about him.
trans: 后来，一位邻居跟我讲起了他的情况。

name: Everybody knows him.
trans: 每个人都知道他。

name: His name is Percy Buttons.
trans: 他的名字叫珀西·巴顿斯（Percy Buttons）。

name: He calls at every house in the street once a month
trans: 他每个月会去街道上的每一户人家拜访一次。

name: and always asks for a meal and a glass of beer.
trans: 并且总是要求吃一顿饭和喝一杯啤酒。

name: Did the detectives save the diamonds?
trans: 侦探们把那些钻石救出来了吗？

name: The plane was late and detectives were waiting at the airport all morning.
trans: 飞机晚点了，侦探们一整个上午都在机场等待。

name: They were expecting a valuable parcel of diamonds from South Africa.
trans: 他们原本期待从南非收到一包裹价值连城的钻石。

name: A few hours earlier,
trans: 几个小时之前，

name: someone had told the police that
trans: 有人向警方报告了这件事。

name: thieves would try to steal the diamonds.
trans: 小偷们会试图偷走那些钻石。

name: When the plane arrived,
trans: 当飞机降临时，

name: some of the detectives were waiting
trans: 一些侦探正在等待。

name: inside the main building
trans: 在主楼内

name: while others were waiting on the airfield.
trans: 而其他人则正在机场等待。

name: Two men took the parcel off the plane
trans: 两名男子从飞机上取下了那个包裹。

name: and carried it into the Customs House.
trans: 然后将其带到了海关大楼。

name: While two detectives were keeping guard at the door,
trans: 当两名侦探在门口站岗时，

name: two others opened the parcel.
trans: 另外两个人打开了那个包裹。

name: To their surprise,
trans: 令他们惊讶的是，

name: the precious parcel was full of stones and sand!
trans: 那个珍贵的包裹里装的全是石头和沙子！

name: Why is Joe's garden
trans: 为什么乔的花园……（The sentence is incomplete; it seems to be the beginning of a question or a description.)
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: the most beautiful one in the town?
trans: 镇上最漂亮的那一个？
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden
trans: 乔·桑德斯拥有最美丽的花园。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: in our town.
trans: 在我们镇上。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: Nearly everybody enters for
trans: 几乎每个人都参加了比赛（或活动等）。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: 'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year,
trans: 每年的“最美丽花园竞赛”（The Nicest Garden Competition）……
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: but Joe wins every time.
trans: 但是乔每次都能赢。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
trans: 比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的花园更大。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: Bill works harder than Joe
trans: 比尔比乔工作更努力。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: and grows more flowers and vegetables,
trans: 并且能种植出更多的鲜花和蔬菜。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: but Joe's garden is more interesting.
trans: 不过乔的花园更有趣。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: He has made neat paths
trans: 他开辟出了一条条整齐的小路（或路径）。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
trans: 并且他们在池塘上建了一座木桥。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: I like gardens too,
trans: 我也喜欢花园。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: but I do not like hard work.
trans: 但我不喜欢辛苦的工作。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: Every year
trans: 每年
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: I enter for the garden competition too,
trans: 我也会参加花园比赛。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: and I always win a little prize
trans: 而且我总能赢得一个小奖品。
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: for the worst garden in the town!
trans: 为了得到镇上最糟糕的花园（即那个条件最差、管理最差的花园）……
lesson: NCE2 · The Best and the Worst

name: What does 'a cold welcome' refer to?
trans: “冷遇”（a cold welcome）指的是一种不热情、冷漠或甚至带有敌意的接待方式。

name: On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall.
trans: 周三晚上，我们去了市政厅。

name: It was the last day of the year
trans: 那是这一年中的最后一天。

name: and a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock.
trans: 一大群人聚集在市政厅的钟楼下方。

name: It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.
trans: 二十分钟后，钟声就会敲响十二下。

name: Fifteen minutes passed and then,
trans: 十五分钟过去了，然后……

name: at five to twelve, the clock stopped.
trans: 从早上五点到中午十二点，时钟一直处于停止状态（没有走动）。

name: The big minute hand did not move.
trans: 那个大型的分针一动也没有动。

name: We waited and waited,
trans: 我们等啊等啊，一直等到很晚。

name: but nothing happened.
trans: 但是什么事情都没有发生。

name: Suddenly someone shouted.
trans: 突然，有人喊了一声。

name: 'It's two minutes past twelve!
trans: 已经十二点过两分了！

name: The clock has stopped!'
trans: “时钟停了！”

name: I looked at my watch.
trans: 我看了看我的手表。

name: It was true.
trans: 确实如此。

name: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.
trans: 那座大钟拒绝为新年的到来“鼓掌”。

name: At that moment, everybody began to laugh and sing.
trans: 就在那一刻，所有人都开始大笑起来，还唱起了歌。

name: What happened to the clavichord?
trans: 那架古钢琴（clavichord）后来怎么样了？

name: We have an old musical instrument.
trans: 我们有一件古老的乐器。

name: It is called a clavichord.
trans: 它被称为“击弦琴”（clavichord）。

name: It was made in Germany in 1681.
trans: 它于1681年在德国制造。

name: Our clavichord is kept in the living room.
trans: 我们的古钢琴被放在客厅里。

name: It has belonged to our family for a long time.
trans: 它已经属于我们家族很长时间了。

name: The instrument was bought by my grandfather many years ago.
trans: 这台仪器是我祖父多年前购买的。

name: Recently it was damaged by a visitor.
trans: 最近，它被一位访客损坏了。

name: She tried to play jazz on it!
trans: 她试图用这台乐器演奏爵士乐！

name: She struck the keys too hard and two of the strings were broken.
trans: 她用力过猛地敲击琴键，结果有两根琴弦断裂了。

name: My father was shocked.
trans: 我父亲非常震惊。

name: Now we are not allowed to touch it.
trans: 现在我们不被允许碰它了。

name: It is being repaired by a friend of my father's.
trans: 它正在被我父亲的一个朋友修理。

name: Who paid for Tony's dinner?
trans: 谁付了托尼晚餐的钱？
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: I was having dinner at a restaurant when Tony Steele came in.
trans: 我正在餐厅吃晚饭，这时托尼·斯蒂尔走了进来。
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: Tony worked in a lawyer's office years ago,
trans: 托尼几年前在一家律师事务所工作过。
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: but he is now working at a bank.
trans: 但他现在在一家银行工作。
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: He gets a good salary,
trans: 他的薪水很高。
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: but he always borrows money from his friends and never pays it back.
trans: 但他总是向朋友借钱，却从不还钱。
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: Tony saw me and came and sat at the same table.
trans: 托尼看到我后，走过来坐在了我的旁边。
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: He has never borrowed money from me.
trans: 他从来没有向我借过钱。
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: While he was eating, I asked him to lend me twenty pounds.
trans: 他正在吃饭的时候，我向他借了二十英镑。
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: To my surprise, he gave me the money immediately.
trans: 令我惊讶的是，他立刻就把钱给了我。
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: 'I have never borrowed any money from you,'
trans: “我从来没有向你借过任何钱。”
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: Tony said, 'so now you can pay for my dinner!'
trans: 托尼说：“现在你可以付我晚餐的钱了！”
lesson: NCE2 · One Good Turn Deserves Another

name: Where is Captain Alison going and how?
trans: 艾莉森上尉要去哪里？又是如何前往那里的？

name: Our neighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow.
trans: 我们的邻居查尔斯·艾利森上尉明天将从朴次茅斯启航。

name: We'll meet him at the harbour early in the morning.
trans: 我们将在清晨在港口与他见面。

name: He will be in his small boat, Topsail.
trans: 他会待在他的小船上，那艘名叫“Topsail”的船。

name: Topsail is a famous little boat.
trans: “Topsail”是一艘非常著名的小船。

name: It has sailed across the Atlantic many times.
trans: 它已经多次横渡了大西洋。

name: Captain Alison will set out at eight o'clock,
trans: 艾莉森船长将在八点钟出发。

name: so we'll have plenty of time.
trans: 所以我们会有足够的时间。

name: We'll see his boat and then we'll say goodbye to him.
trans: 我们会看到他的船，然后向他道别。

name: He will be away for two months.
trans: 他将会离开两个月。

name: We are very proud of him.
trans: 我们为他感到非常骄傲。

name: He will take part in an important race across the Atlantic.
trans: 他将参加一场横跨大西洋的重要比赛。

name: Why will the police have a difficult time?
trans: 为什么警察会遇到困难呢？

name: The Greenwood Boys are a group of pop singers.
trans: The Greenwood Boys是一支流行歌手组合。

name: At present, they are visiting all parts of the country.
trans: 目前，他们正在访问该国的各个地区。

name: They will be arriving here tomorrow.
trans: 他们明天会到达这里。

name: They will be coming by train and most of the young people in the town will be meeting them at the station.
trans: 他们将乘火车前来，镇上的大多数年轻人都会在火车站迎接他们。

name: Tomorrow evening they will be singing at the Workers' Club.
trans: 明天晚上，他们将在工人俱乐部唱歌。

name: The Greenwood Boys will be staying for five days.
trans: 格林伍德男孩们将会在这里停留五天。

name: During this time, they will give five performances.
trans: 在这段时间里，他们将进行五场演出。

name: As usual, the police will have a difficult time.
trans: 像往常一样，警方会遇到很大的困难。

name: They will be trying to keep order.
trans: 他们会努力维持秩序。

name: It is always the same on these occasions.
trans: 每次遇到这种情况，情况总是千篇一律的。

name: Did the young man speak English?
trans: 那个年轻人会说英语吗？

name: I had an amusing experience last year.
trans: 去年我有一段非常有趣的经历。

name: After I had left a small village in the south of France,
trans: 在我离开法国南部的一个小村庄之后……

name: I drove on to the next town.
trans: 我继续开车前往下一个城镇。

name: On the way, a young man waved to me.
trans: 在路上，一个年轻人向我挥手致意。

name: I stopped and he asked me for a lift.
trans: 我停了下来，他请求我载他一程。

name: As soon as he had got into the car,
trans: 他一上车，

name: I said good morning to him in French and he replied in the same language.
trans: 我用法语向他道了早安，他也用同样的语言回应了我。

name: Apart from a few words,
trans: 除了几个单词之外，

name: I do not know any French at all.
trans: 我完全不会说法语。

name: Neither of us spoke during the journey.
trans: 在旅途中，我们俩都没有说话。

name: I had nearly reached the town, when the young man suddenly said, very slowly,
trans: 我差不多已经走到镇上了，这时那个年轻人突然非常缓慢地说：

name: 'Do you speak English?'
trans: “你会说英语吗？”

name: As I soon learnt, he was English himself!
trans: 很快我就发现，他本人就是英国人！

name: What was the good news?
trans: 那条好消息是什么呢？

name: The secretary told me that Mr. Harmsworth would see me.
trans: 秘书告诉我，哈姆斯沃思先生会见我。

name: I felt very nervous when I went into his office.
trans: 当我走进他的办公室时，我感到非常紧张。

name: He did not look up from his desk when I entered.
trans: 我进来的时候，他一直低着头，没有从书桌前抬起头来。

name: After I had sat down,
trans: 在我坐下之后，

name: he said that business was very bad.
trans: 他说生意非常糟糕。

name: He told me that the firm could not afford to pay such large salaries.
trans: 他告诉我，公司无力支付如此高的薪水。

name: Twenty people had already left.
trans: 已经有二十个人离开了。

name: I knew that my turn had come.
trans: 我知道我的时刻终于到了。

name: 'Mr. Harmsworth,' I said in a weak voice.
trans: “哈姆斯沃思先生，”我虚弱地说道。

name: 'Don't interrupt,' he said.
trans: “不要打断我，”他说。

name: Then he smiled and told me I would receive an extra thousand pounds a year!
trans: 然后他笑了，告诉我每年我还能多收到一千英镑！

name: What was the polite request?
trans: 那个礼貌的请求是什么？

name: If you park your car in the wrong place,
trans: 如果你把车停在了错误的地方，

name: a traffic policeman will soon find it.
trans: 交通警察很快就会发现。

name: You will be very lucky if he lets you go without a ticket.
trans: 如果你能不被开罚单就放你走，那你就非常幸运了。

name: However, this does not always happen.
trans: 不过，这种情况并不总是发生。

name: Traffic police are sometimes very polite.
trans: 有时候，交通警察会非常礼貌。

name: During a holiday in Sweden,
trans: 在瑞典的一个假期里，

name: I found this note on my car:
trans: 我在我的车上发现了一张纸条：

name: 'sir, we welcome you to our city. This is a No Parking area.
trans: “先生，欢迎您来到我们的城市。这里是不允许停车的区域。

name: You will enjoy your stay here if you pay attention to our street signs. This note is only a reminder.'
trans: 如果您注意看街道上的标志，您的停留会非常愉快。这张纸条只是为了提醒您而已。”

name: If you receive a request like this, you cannot fail to obey it!
trans: 如果你收到了这样的请求，你绝对不能不遵守它！

name: Why doesn't Aunt Jennifer tell anyone how old she is?
trans: 为什么詹妮弗阿姨从不告诉别人她的真实年龄呢？

name: My aunt Jennifer is an actress.
trans: 我的阿姨詹妮弗是一名演员。

name: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
trans: 她至少有 thirty-five 岁了。

name: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
trans: 尽管如此，她仍然经常以年轻女孩的形象出现在舞台上。

name: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
trans: 詹妮弗很快将不得不参加一部新的戏剧演出。

name: This time, she will be a girl of seventeen.
trans: 这一次，她将是一个十七岁的女孩。

name: In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
trans: 在剧中，她必须穿着一件亮红色的连衣裙和一双长长的黑色长袜出场。

name: Last year in another play,
trans: 去年，在另一部戏剧中……

name: she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress.
trans: 她不得不穿短袜和一条鲜艳的橙色连衣裙。

name: If anyone ever asks her how old she is,
trans: 如果有人问她多大了，

name: she always answers, 'Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!'
trans: 她总是回答：“亲爱的，长大一定很可怕吧！”

name: What had happened to the writer's bag?
trans: 作家的包到底发生了什么事？

name: After I had had lunch at a village pub, I looked for my bag.
trans: 在一家乡村酒吧吃过午饭后，我开始寻找我的包。

name: I had left it on a chair beside the door and now it wasn't there!
trans: 我之前把它放在门旁边的椅子上，但现在它不见了！

name: As I was looking for it, the landlord came in.
trans: 就在我找东西的时候，房东进来了。

name: 'Did you have a good meal?' he asked.
trans: “你吃得怎么样？”他问道。

name: 'Yes, thank you,' I answered, 'but I can't pay the bill. I haven't got my bag.'
trans: “是的，谢谢您，”我回答道，“但我付不起这笔账单。我的包还没拿回来。”

name: The landlord smiled and immediately went out.
trans: 房东微笑着，立刻走了出去。

name: In a few minutes he returned with my bag and gave it back to me.
trans: 几分钟后，他拿着我的包回来了，并把它交还给了我。

name: 'I'm very sorry,' he said.
trans: “我非常抱歉，”他说。

name: 'My dog had taken it into the garden. He often does this!'
trans: 我的狗把那个东西带到了花园里。它经常这么做！

name: When will the writer see the play?
trans: 作家什么时候能看到这部剧呢？

name: 'The play may begin at any moment,' I said.
trans: “这部剧随时都可能上演，”我说。

name: 'It may have begun already,' Susan answered.
trans: “也许它已经上演了，”苏珊回答。

name: I hurried to the ticket office.
trans: 我赶紧跑向售票处。

name: 'May I have two tickets please?' I asked.
trans: “请给我两张票，好吗？”我请求道。

name: 'I'm sorry, we've sold out,' the girl said.
trans: “很抱歉，票已经卖完了，”女孩说。

name: 'What a pity!' Susan exclaimed.
trans: “真遗憾！”苏珊感叹道。

name: Just then, a man hurried to the ticket office.
trans: 就在这时，一个男人匆匆跑到了售票处。

name: 'Can I return these two tickets?' he asked.
trans: “我可以退掉这两张票吗？”他问道。

name: 'Certainly,' the girl said.
trans: “当然可以，”女孩回答。

name: I went back to the ticket office at once.
trans: 我立刻又回到了售票处。

name: 'Could I have those two tickets please?' I asked.
trans: “请把那两张票给我，好吗？”我再次请求道。

name: 'Certainly,' the girl said,
trans: “当然可以，”女孩说道。

name: 'but they're for next Wednesday's performance.
trans: 但这些是用于下周三的演出准备的。

name: Do you still want them?'
trans: “你还需要它们吗？”

name: 'I might as well have them,' I said sadly.
trans: “我还不如把它们都拿下来呢，”我悲伤地说。

name: Why is fishing the writer's favourite sport?
trans: 为什么钓鱼是这位作家最喜爱的运动呢？
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: Fishing is my favourite sport.
trans: 钓鱼是我最喜欢的运动。
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: I often fish for hours without catching anything.
trans: 我经常花好几个小时钓鱼，却什么也没钓到。
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: But this does not worry me.
trans: 但这并不让我担心。
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: Some fishermen are unlucky.
trans: 有些渔民运气不好。
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: Instead of catching fish,
trans: 与其去捕鱼，
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: they catch old boots and rubbish.
trans: 他们收集旧靴子和垃圾。
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: I am even less lucky.
trans: 我的运气更差了。
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: I never catch anything  --  not even old boots.
trans: 我从来什么也抓不到——连一双旧靴子都抓不到。
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: After having spent whole mornings on the river,
trans: 在河边度过了整个上午之后……
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: I always go home with an empty bag.
trans: 我每次回家时，包里总是空空的。
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: 'You must give up fishing!' my friends say. 'It's a waste of time.'
trans: “你必须放弃钓鱼！”我的朋友们说，“那纯粹是浪费时间。”
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: But they don't realize one important thing.
trans: 但他们没有意识到一件重要的事情：
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: I'm not really interested in fishing.
trans: 我其实对钓鱼并不感兴趣。
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: I am only interested in sitting in a boat and doing nothing at all!
trans: 我真正感兴趣的，只是坐在船上什么都不做而已！
lesson: NCE2 · One Man in a Boat

name: Why do people think the writer is mad?
trans: 为什么人们认为这位作者疯了？

name: Aeroplanes are slowly driving me mad.
trans: 飞机声真的快把我逼疯了。

name: I live near an airport and passing planes can be heard night and day.
trans: 我住在机场附近，无论白天还是黑夜，都能听到飞机的轰鸣声。

name: The airport was built years ago, but for some reason it could not be used then.
trans: 这个机场几年前就建好了，但不知为何当时无法投入使用。

name: Last year, however, it came into use.
trans: 然而去年，它终于开始运营了。

name: Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise.
trans: 由于噪音的影响，至少有一百多人被迫离开了他们的家园。

name: I am one of the few people left.
trans: 我是少数还留在这里的人之一。

name: Sometimes I think this house will be knocked down by a passing plane.
trans: 有时候我觉得，这栋房子随时可能被飞过的飞机撞倒。

name: I have been offered a large sum of money to go away, but I am determined to stay here.
trans: 有人出高价让我搬走，但我坚决要留在这里。

name: Everybody says I must be mad and they are probably right.
trans: 大家都说我一定是疯了，也许他们是对的。

name: How did Jane receive a letter from a stranger?
trans: 简是怎么收到一封来自陌生人的信的？

name: My daughter, Jane, never dreamed of receiving a letter from a girl of her own age in Holland.
trans: 我的女儿简，从未想过会收到来自荷兰的一个同龄女孩的信。

name: Last year, we were travelling across the Channel and Jane put a piece of paper with her name and address on it into a bottle.
trans: 去年，我们在渡英吉利海峡时，简把一张写有她名字和地址的纸条放进了瓶子里。

name: She threw the bottle into the sea.
trans: 她把瓶子扔进了海里。

name: She never thought of it again, but ten months later, she received a letter from a girl in Holland.
trans: 她再也没有想起过这件事，但十个月后，她收到了一封来自荷兰女孩的信。

name: Both girls write to each other regularly now.
trans: 现在，这两个女孩经常互相写信。

name: However, they have decided to use the post office.
trans: 然而，他们决定使用邮局来办理相关事务。

name: Letters will cost a little more, but they will certainly travel faster.
trans: 信件的费用会稍高一些，但它们的传递速度肯定更快。

name: Why is the new house special?
trans: 为什么这栋新房子这么特别呢？

name: I had a letter from my sister yesterday.
trans: 我昨天收到了姐姐的一封信。

name: She lives in Nigeria.
trans: 她住在尼日利亚。

name: In her letter, she said that she would come to England next year.
trans: 在她的信中，她说她明年会来英格兰。

name: If she comes, she will get a surprise.
trans: 如果她来了，她会收到一个惊喜。

name: We are now living in a beautiful new house in the country.
trans: 我们现在住在乡下的一栋漂亮的新房子里。

name: Work on it had begun before my sister left.
trans: 在我妹妹离开之前，相关工作就已经开始了。

name: The house was completed five months ago.
trans: 这栋房子是在五个月前建成的。

name: In my letter, I told her that she could stay with us.
trans: 在我的信里，我告诉她可以和我们一起住。

name: The house has many large rooms and there is a lovely garden.
trans: 这栋房子有很多宽敞的房间，还有一个非常漂亮的花园。

name: It is a very modern house, so it looks strange to some people.
trans: 这是一栋非常现代化的房子，因此有些人会觉得它看起来很奇怪。

name: It must be the only modern house in the district.
trans: 这肯定是该地区唯一一座现代化的房屋了。

name: Had the writer's money been stolen?
trans: 那位作家的钱被偷了吗？

name: I entered the hotel manager's office and sat down.
trans: 我走进酒店经理的办公室，坐了下来。

name: I had just lost ￡50 and I felt very upset.
trans: 我刚刚损失了50英镑，感到非常沮丧。

name: 'I left the money in my room,' I said, 'and it's not there now.  '
trans: “我把钱放在房间里了，但现在钱不见了。”我说。

name: The manager was sympathetic, but he could do nothing.
trans: 经理很同情我，但他无能为力。

name: 'Everyone's losing money these days,' he said.
trans: “这些天大家都在亏钱。”他说。

name: He started to complain about this wicked world but was interrupted by a knock at the door.
trans: 他开始抱怨这个糟糕的世界，但这时门被敲响了。

name: A girl came in and put an envelope on his desk.
trans: 一个女孩走了进来，把一个信封放在他的桌子上。

name: It contained ￡50.
trans: 信封里装着50英镑。

name: 'I found this outside this gentleman's room,' she said.
trans: “我在这位先生的房间外面发现了这个。”她说。

name: 'Well,' I said to the manager,'there is still some honesty in this world!'
trans: “嗯，”我对经理说，“这个世界上还是有一些诚实的人的！”

name: Do they speak English?
trans: 他们说英语吗？
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: Why does the writer not understand the porter?
trans: 为什么作者听不懂那个行李搬运工的话？
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: I arrived in London at last.
trans: 我终于到了伦敦。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: The railway station was big, black and dark.
trans: 火车站又大又黑，显得非常阴暗。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: I did not know the way to my hotel, so I asked a porter.
trans: 我不知道怎么去我的酒店，于是我问了一个行李搬运工。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: I not only spoke English very carefully, but very clearly as well.
trans: 我不仅说英语非常小心、非常仔细，而且发音也非常清晰。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: The porter, however, could not understand me.
trans: 然而，那个行李搬运工却听不懂我。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: I repeated my question several times and at last he understood.
trans: 我重复了几次我的问题，最后他才明白了。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: he answered me, but he spoke neither slowly nor clearly.
trans: 他回答了我，但他的说话速度既不慢也不清晰。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: 'I am a foreigner,' I said.
trans: “我是外国人，”我说。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: Then he spoke slowly, but I could not understand him.
trans: 然后他放慢了语速，但我还是听不懂他。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: My teacher never spoke English like that!
trans: 我的老师从来都不会用那样的方式说英语！
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: The porter and I looked at each other and smiled.
trans: 门房和我对视了一眼，然后都笑了。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: Then he said something and I understood it.
trans: 接着他说了些什么，我听懂了。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: 'You'll soon learn English!' he said.
trans: “你很快就能学会英语了！”他说。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: I wonder.
trans: 我很好奇……
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: In England, each person speaks a different language.
trans: 在英格兰，每个人说着不同的语言。
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: The English understand each other, but I don't understand them!
trans: 英国人之间可以互相理解，但我却听不懂他们的话！
lesson: NCE2 · Do the English Speak English?

name: Who is the student's best critic?
trans: 谁是这个学生最好的批评者（或者说，谁最能帮助这个学生改进自己）？

name: I am an art student and I paint a lot of pictures.
trans: 我是一名艺术学生，经常画很多画。

name: Many people pretend that they understand modern art.
trans: 很多人假装自己理解现代艺术。

name: They always tell you what a picture is 'about'.
trans: 他们总是告诉你一张图片“讲述”的是什么内容（即图片所表达的主题或故事）。

name: Of course, many pictures are not 'about' anything.
trans: 当然，很多图片其实并没有明确的主题或意义（即它们“并不表达任何特定的内容”）。

name: They are just pretty patterns.
trans: 它们只不过是一些漂亮的图案罢了。

name: We like them in the same way that we like pretty curtain material.
trans: 我们喜欢它们的方式，就如同我们喜欢漂亮的窗帘面料一样。

name: I think that young children often appreciate modern pictures better than anyone else.
trans: 我认为，年幼的孩子们往往比其他任何人都更喜欢现代风格的画作。

name: They notice more.
trans: 他们注意到了更多细节（或情况）。

name: My sister is only seven,
trans: 我妹妹才七岁。

name: but she always tells me whether my pictures are good or not.
trans: 但她总是会告诉我我的照片好不好。

name: She came into my room yesterday.
trans: 她昨天进了我的房间。

name: 'What are you doing?' she asked.
trans: “你在做什么？”她问。

name: 'I'm hanging this picture on the wall,' I answered. 'It's a new one. Do you like it?'
trans: “我在把这幅画挂在墙上。”我回答说，“这是一幅新画。你喜欢吗？”

name: She looked at it critically for a moment.
trans: 她仔细地看了一会儿。

name: 'It's all right,' she said, 'but isn't it upside down?'
trans: “还行吧，”她说，“不过它不是倒挂了吗？”

name: I looked at it again.
trans: 我又看了一遍。

name: She was right! It was!
trans: 她说得对！确实是这样！

name: What happened to the boys in the night?
trans: 晚上那些男孩们发生了什么事？

name: Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.
trans: 傍晚时分，男孩们在田野中央搭起了帐篷。

name: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire.
trans: 帐篷搭好后，他们就在明火旁做饭。

name: They were all hungry and the food smelled good.
trans: 大家都很饿，食物闻起来非常香。

name: After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the campfire.
trans: 吃完美味的饭菜后，他们在篝火旁讲故事、唱歌。

name: But some time later it began to rain.
trans: 但不久之后，天开始下雨了。

name: The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent.
trans: 男孩们感到疲惫，于是熄灭了火，然后钻进了帐篷。

name: Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly.
trans: 他们的睡袋温暖舒适，大家都睡得很香。

name: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting.
trans: 半夜时分，有两个男孩突然醒来，开始大喊大叫。

name: The tent was full of water!
trans: 帐篷里充满了水！

name: They all leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside.
trans: 他们立刻从睡袋里爬出来，匆忙跑到外面。

name: It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field.
trans: 雨下得很大，他们发现田野里形成了一条小溪。

name: The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!
trans: 小溪蜿蜒流过田野，然后从他们的帐篷下方流过！

name: What is Jasper White's problem?
trans: 贾斯珀·怀特到底有什么问题？

name: Jasper White is one of those rare people who believes in ancient myths.
trans: 贾斯珀·怀特是少数相信古代神话的人之一。

name: He has just bought a new house in the city, but ever since he moved in, he has had trouble with cars and their owners.
trans: 他刚在城里买了一套新房子，但从搬进去之后，他就一直遇到各种与汽车及其车主相关的问题（比如汽车故障、车主的不当行为等等）。

name: When he returns home at night, he always finds that someone has parked a car outside his gate.
trans: 每当他晚上回到家时，总会发现有人把车停在了他家大门的外面。

name: Because of this, he has not been able to get his own car into his garage even once.
trans: 正因为如此，他一次都无法将自己的汽车开进自己的车库。

name: Jasper has put up 'No Parking' signs outside his gate, but these have not had any effect.
trans: 贾斯珀在他的大门外竖起了“禁止停车”的标志，但这些标志根本没有任何作用。

name: Now he has put an ugly stone head over the gate.
trans: 现在，他在大门上安装了一个丑陋的石制雕像。

name: It is one of the ugliest faces I have ever seen.
trans: 这是我见过的最丑陋的面孔之一。

name: I asked him what it was and he told me that it was Medusa, the Gorgon.
trans: 我问他那是什么，他告诉我那叫美杜莎，一个戈耳工。

name: Jasper hopes that she will turn cars and their owners to stone.
trans: 贾斯珀希望她能够将汽车及其车主变成石头。

name: But none of them has been turned to stone yet!
trans: 但是，它们当中还没有任何一个变成石头呢！

name: Does Captain Fawcett think any trip is too dangerous?
trans: 福塞特船长认为有任何旅行是过于危险的吗？

name: Captain Ben Fawcett has bought an unusual taxi and has begun a new service.
trans: 本·福塞特船长买了一辆与众不同的出租车，并开始提供一项新的服务。

name: The 'taxi' is a small Swiss aeroplane called a 'Pilatus Porter'.
trans: 这架“出租车”其实是一架小型瑞士飞机，被称为“Pilatus Porter”。

name: This wonderful plane can carry seven passengers.
trans: 这架出色的飞机可以搭载七名乘客。

name: The most surprising thing about it, however, is that it can land anywhere: on snow, water, or even on a ploughed field.
trans: 然而，最令人惊讶的是：它可以在任何地方降落——无论是雪地上、水面上，还是已经翻耕过的田地里。

name: Captain Fawcett's first passenger was a doctor who flew from Birmingham to a lonely village in the Welsh mountains.
trans: 福塞特船长的第一位乘客是一位医生，他乘坐飞机从伯明翰飞往威尔士山区的一个偏远村庄。

name: Since then, Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.
trans: 从那以后，福塞特船长已经将乘客们送往了许多非常奇特、不寻常的地方。

name: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats and on another occasion, he landed in a deserted car park.
trans: 有一次，他降落在一栋公寓楼的屋顶上；另一次，他则降落在一个废弃的停车场里。

name: Captain Fawcett has just refused a strange request from a businessman.
trans: 福塞特船长刚刚拒绝了一位商人的奇怪请求。

name: The man wanted to fly to Rockall, a lonely island in the Atlantic Ocean,
trans: 这个人想要飞往罗卡尔岛（Rockall），那是大西洋上一座孤寂的岛屿。

name: but Captain Fawcett did not take him because the trip was too dangerous.
trans: 但是福塞特船长没有带上他，因为这次旅行太危险了。

name: What happened to the man in the boat?
trans: 那个在船上的男人发生了什么事？

name: The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park near my home.
trans: 韦尔河是一条小河，流经我家附近的公园。

name: I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons.
trans: 我喜欢在天气好的下午坐在韦尔河畔。

name: It was warm last Sunday, so I went and sat on the river bank as usual.
trans: 上周日天气很暖和，所以我像往常一样去了河边坐。

name: Some children were playing games on the bank and there were some people rowing on the river.
trans: 有些孩子在河岸上玩游戏，还有一些人在河上划船。

name: Suddenly, one of the children kicked a ball very hard and it went towards a passing boat.
trans: 突然，其中一个孩子用力踢了一个球，球飞向了一艘正在经过的船。

name: Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat, but he did not hear them.
trans: 河岸上的一些人向船上的男人喊话，但他没有听到。

name: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
trans: 球击中他的力度很大，差点让他掉进水里。

name: I turned to look at the children, but there weren't any in sight: they had all run away!
trans: 我转身看向那些孩子，但他们已经不见了——他们都跑掉了！

name: The man laughed when he realized what had happened.
trans: 当那个男人意识到发生了什么时，他笑了起来。

name: He called out to the children and threw the ball back to the bank.
trans: 他向孩子们喊了一声，然后把球扔回了河岸上。

name: What was Frank's first job?
trans: 弗兰克的第一份工作是什么？

name: Yesterday afternoon Frank Hawkins was telling me about
trans: 昨天下午，弗兰克·霍金斯跟我讲起了这件事。

name: his experiences as a young man.
trans: 他年轻时的经历。

name: Before he retired,
trans: 在他退休之前，

name: Frank was the head of
trans: 弗兰克是……的负责人（或主管）。

name: a very large business company, but as a boy he used to work in a small shop.
trans: 这是一家规模非常大的企业，但小时候他曾在一家小商店里工作过。

name: It was his job to repair bicycles
trans: 他的工作就是修理自行车。

name: and at that time he used to work fourteen hours a day.
trans: 那时，他每天要工作十四个小时。

name: He saved money for years and
trans: 他多年来一直存钱，

name: in 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
trans: 1958年，他买下了属于自己的一个小作坊。

name: In his twenties Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
trans: 二十多岁的时候，弗兰克经常为飞机制造零部件。

name: At that time he had two helpers.
trans: 当时他有两个助手。

name: In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory
trans: 几年后，那个小作坊已经发展成了一家大工厂。

name: which employed seven hundred and twenty-eight people.
trans: 该公司雇用了七百二十八名员工。

name: Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years and the long road to success.
trans: 弗兰克想起自己早年艰难的岁月以及通往成功的漫长道路时，露出了微笑。

name: He was still smiling when the door opened and his wife came in.
trans: 门打开时，他仍在微笑，他的妻子走了进来。

name: She wanted him to repair their grandson's bicycle!
trans: 她希望他能修理他们孙子的自行车！

name: Who was the thief?
trans: 谁是小偷？

name: People are not so honest as
trans: 人们并没有那么诚实……

name: they once were.
trans: 他们曾经是这样的。

name: The temptation to steal is greater than
trans: 偷窃的诱惑力比……（原句后半部分缺失，无法完整翻译）

name: ever before--especially in large shops.
trans: 前所未有——尤其是在大型商店里。

name: A detective recently watched a well-dressed
trans: 最近，一名侦探观察了一名穿着考究的人……

name: woman who always went into a large store
trans: 那个总是去大型商店的女人

name: on Monday mornings.
trans: 每周一早上。

name: One Monday,
trans: 一个星期一的早晨，

name: there were fewer people in the shop
trans: 商店里的人变少了。

name: than usual when the woman came in,
trans: 当那位女士走进来时，情况比平时更加紧张（或：气氛比平时更加热烈/激动）。

name: so it was easier for the detective to watch her.
trans: 因此，侦探更容易监视她了。

name: The woman first bought a few small articles.
trans: 这位女士首先购买了几件小商品。

name: After a little time,
trans: 过了一会儿，

name: she chose one of the most expensive dresses
trans: 她选了一条价格最贵的裙子。

name: in the shop and handed it to an assistant
trans: 我在店里，把它交给了一个店员。

name: who wrapped it up for her as quickly as possible.
trans: 谁尽快为她完成了这件事（或：谁帮她把事情处理得井井有条）。

name: Then the woman simply took the parcel
trans: 然后，那个女人直接拿走了那个包裹。

name: and walked out of the shop without paying.
trans: 然后他没付钱就走出了商店。

name: When she was arrested,
trans: 当她被逮捕时，

name: the detective found out that
trans: 侦探发现……

name: the shop assistant was her daughter.
trans: 那位店员其实是她的女儿。

name: The girl 'gave' her mother
trans: 那个女孩把东西“给了”她的母亲。

name: a free dress once a week!
trans: 每周可以免费获得一件连衣裙！

name: Why was the girl in hospital?
trans: 为什么那个女孩要住院呢？

name: Nearly a week passed before
trans: 差不多过了一个星期，才……

name: the girl was able to explain
trans: 那个女孩能够解释清楚。

name: what had happened to her.
trans: 她到底发生了什么事？

name: One afternoon she set out
trans: 一个下午，她出发了。

name: from the coast in a small boat
trans: 从海岸出发，乘坐一艘小船。

name: and was caught in a storm.
trans: 结果被一场暴风雨困住了。

name: Towards evening,
trans: 到了傍晚时分，

name: the boat struck a rock and
trans: 船撞上了一块岩石。

name: the girl jumped into the sea.
trans: 那个女孩跳进了海里。

name: Then she swam to the shore
trans: 然后她游到了岸边。

name: after spending the whole night in the water.
trans: 在水中度过了一整夜之后……

name: During that time she covered
trans: 在那段时间里，她负责报道（或记录）了相关事件。

name: a distance of eight miles.
trans: 八英里的距离。

name: Early next morning,
trans: 第二天清晨，

name: she saw a light ahead.
trans: 她看到前方有一道光。

name: She knew she was near the shore
trans: 她知道自己已经接近海岸了。

name: because the light was high up on the cliffs.
trans: 因为灯光位于悬崖的高处。

name: On arriving at the shore,
trans: 当他们到达岸边时，

name: the girl struggled up the cliff towards
trans: 那个女孩费力地爬上了悬崖，朝着……（句子未完成，后续内容缺失）

name: the light she had seen.
trans: 她所看到的那道光。

name: That was all she remembered.
trans: 那就是她所记得的全部内容了。

name: When she woke up a day later,
trans: 一天后，当她醒来时……

name: she found herself in hospital.
trans: 她被送进了医院。

name: How long had the police taken to find his bicycle?
trans: 警察花了多长时间才找到他的自行车？

name: Dan Robinson has been worried all week.
trans: 丹·罗宾逊整个星期都一直很担心。

name: Last Tuesday he received a letter
trans: 上周二，他收到了一封信。

name: from the local police.
trans: 来自当地警方。

name: In the letter he was asked to call at the station.
trans: 在信中，他被要求去车站一趟。

name: Dan wondered why
trans: 丹想知道为什么。

name: he was wanted by the police,
trans: 他被警方通缉了。

name: but he went to the station yesterday
trans: 但他昨天去车站了。

name: and now he is not worried anymore.
trans: 现在他不再担心了。

name: At the station,
trans: 在车站里，

name: he was told by a smiling policeman
trans: 一位面带微笑的警察告诉了他这件事。

name: that his bicycle had been found.
trans: 他的自行车已经被找到了。

name: Five days ago, the policeman told him,
trans: 五天前，警察对他说：

name: the bicycle was picked up in a small village
trans: 这辆自行车是在一个小镇上被捡到的。

name: four hundred miles away.
trans: 四百英里之外。

name: It is now being sent to his home by train.
trans: 它现在正通过火车被送往他的家中。

name: Dan was most surprised
trans: 丹感到最为惊讶。

name: when he heard the news.
trans: 当他听到这个消息时……

name: He was amused too,
trans: 他也很觉得有趣。

name: because he never expected
trans: 因为他从未预料到会发生这样的事。

name: the bicycle to be found.
trans: 需要找到那辆自行车。

name: It was stolen twenty years ago
trans: 它是在二十年前被偷走的。

name: when Dan was a boy of fifteen!
trans: 那是丹十五岁的时候！

name: How did Roy stop the thieves?
trans: 罗伊是如何阻止那些小偷的？

name: Roy Trenton used to drive a taxi.
trans: 罗伊·特伦顿以前开过出租车。

name: A short while ago, however,
trans: 然而，就在不久前……

name: he became a bus driver
trans: 他成了一名公交车司机。

name: and he has not regretted it.
trans: 他从未为此感到后悔。

name: He is finding his new work far more exciting.
trans: 他发现自己的新工作要有趣得多。

name: When he was driving
trans: 当他开车的时候

name: along Catford Street recently,
trans: 最近，在卡特福德街（Catford Street）上……

name: he saw two thieves rush out of a shop
trans: 他看到两个小偷从商店里冲了出来。

name: and run towards a waiting car.
trans: 然后跑向一辆正在等待的车辆。

name: One of them was carrying a bag full of money.
trans: 其中一个人带着一个装满钱的袋子。

name: Roy acted quickly and drove the bus
trans: 罗伊反应迅速，立刻驾驶着公交车离开了现场。

name: straight at the thieves.
trans: 直接冲向那些小偷。

name: The one with the money got such a fright
trans: 那个有钱的人吓得要命。

name: that he dropped the bag.
trans: 那就是他掉了那个包。

name: As the thieves were trying to get away in their car,
trans: 当小偷们试图开车逃跑时，

name: Roy drove his bus into the back of it.
trans: 罗伊驾驶他的公交车撞上了那辆车的后部。

name: While the battered car was moving away,
trans: 当那辆破旧的汽车缓缓驶离时……

name: Roy stopped his bus and telephoned the police.
trans: 罗伊停下了他的公交车，然后拨打了报警电话。

name: The thieves' car was badly damaged and easy to recognize.
trans: 小偷们的汽车损坏严重，因此很容易被辨认出来。

name: Shortly afterwards,
trans: 不久之后，

name: the police stopped the car and both men were arrested.
trans: 警察拦下了那辆车，两名男子都被逮捕了。

name: What is Debbie going to try to do?
trans: 黛比打算做什么呢？

name: Debbie Hart is going to swim
trans: 黛比·哈特要去游泳了。

name: across the English Channel tomorrow.
trans: 明天将渡过英吉利海峡。

name: She is going to set out from the French coast
trans: 她将从法国海岸出发。

name: at five o'clock in the morning.
trans: 早上五点。

name: Debbie is only eleven years old
trans: 黛比只有十一岁。

name: and she hopes to set up a new world record.
trans: 她希望能够创造一项新的世界纪录。

name: She is a strong swimmer and many people feel
trans: 她是个游泳能力很强的运动员，很多人都认为……

name: that she is sure to succeed.
trans: 她确信自己一定会成功。

name: Debbie's father will set out with her
trans: 黛比的父亲会和她一起出发。

name: in a small boat.
trans: 在一艘小船上。

name: Mr. Hart has trained his daughter for years.
trans: 哈特先生多年来一直在训练他的女儿。

name: Tomorrow he will be watching her anxiously
trans: 明天，他会焦急地注视着她。

name: as she swims the long distance to England.
trans: 当她游过漫长的距离前往英格兰时……

name: Debbie intends to take short rests every two hours.
trans: 黛比打算每两小时休息一会儿。

name: She will have something to drink
trans: 她会有东西喝的。

name: but she will not eat any solid food.
trans: 但她拒绝吃任何固体食物。

name: Most of Debbie's school friends will be
trans: Debbie的大多数同学都会……

name: waiting for her on the English coast.
trans: 在英格兰的海岸边等待着她。

name: Among them will be Debbie's mother,
trans: 其中会包括黛比的母亲。

name: who swam the Channel herself
trans: 谁是那个自己游过英吉利海峡的人？

name: when she was a girl.
trans: 当她还是个女孩的时候。

name: When was the last time this country
trans: 这个国家上一次……是什么时候？

name: hosted the Olympic Games?
trans: 哪个国家主办过奥运会？

name: The Olympic Games will be held
trans: 奥运会将会举行。

name: in our country in four years' time.
trans: 在我们国家，四年后就会发生这种情况。

name: As a great many people will be
trans: 正如许多人将会做的那样……

name: visiting the country,
trans: 访问这个国家

name: the government will be building new hotels,
trans: 政府将会建造新的酒店。

name: an immense stadium,
trans: 一个巨大的体育场。

name: and a new Olympic-standard swimming pool.
trans: 以及一个符合奥运标准的游泳池。

name: They will also be building new roads
trans: 他们还将修建新的道路。

name: and a special railway line.
trans: 以及一条专门的铁路线。

name: The Games will be held just outside the capital
trans: 比赛将在首都郊外举行。

name: and the whole area will be called 'Olympic City'.
trans: 整个区域将被命名为“奥林匹克城”。

name: Workers will have completed the new roads
trans: 工人们将会完成这些新道路的建设。

name: by the end of this year.
trans: 到今年年底为止。

name: By the end of next year,
trans: 到明年年底为止，

name: they will have finished work on the new stadium.
trans: 他们将会完成新体育场的相关建设工作。

name: The fantastic modern buildings have been designed
trans: 这些令人惊叹的现代建筑都是经过精心设计的。

name: by Kurt Gunter.
trans: 作者：库尔特·冈特（Kurt Gunter）。

name: Everybody will be watching anxiously
trans: 每个人都会焦急地等待着结果。

name: as the new buildings go up.
trans: 随着新建筑的陆续建成……

name: We are all very excited and are looking forward to
trans: 我们都非常兴奋，都在期待着……

name: the Olympic Games because
trans: 因为奥运会……

name: they have never been held before in this country.
trans: 这种活动（或物品）在这个国家以前从未出现过。

name: Why did Harrison sell his house so quickly?
trans: 为什么哈里森这么快就卖掉了他的房子？

name: My old friend, Harrison, had lived in
trans: 我的老朋友哈里森曾经住在这里。

name: the Mediterranean for many years
trans: 多年来，地中海地区一直是人们关注的焦点（或：多年来，地中海地区一直备受人们的关注）。

name: before he returned to England.
trans: 在他回到英格兰之前。

name: He had often dreamed of retiring in England
trans: 他经常梦想着在英格兰退休。

name: and had planned to settle down in the country.
trans: 并且原本计划在这个乡村安顿下来生活。

name: He had no sooner returned than he bought
trans: 他一回来，就立刻买了东西。

name: a house and went to live there.
trans: 他们买了一栋房子，然后搬去那里住了。

name: Almost immediately he began to complain
trans: 几乎立刻，他就开始抱怨起来。

name: about the weather,
trans: 关于天气的情况。

name: for even though it was still summer,
trans: 因为尽管那时仍是夏天……

name: it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold.
trans: 雨一直下个不停，天气也常常非常寒冷。

name: After so many years of sunshine,
trans: 经历了这么多年的阳光照耀之后……

name: Harrison got a shock.
trans: 哈里森感到非常震惊。

name: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
trans: 他的举止就好像他以前从未在英国生活过一样。

name: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
trans: 最终，这超出了他的承受能力。

name: He had hardly had time to settle down
trans: 他几乎还没来得及安顿下来呢。

name: when he sold the house and left the country.
trans: 当他卖掉房子并离开这个国家的时候。

name: The dream he had had for so many years ended there.
trans: 他多年来一直怀有的梦想，就在那一刻结束了。

name: Harrison had thought of everything except the weather.
trans: 哈里森考虑到了所有可能的因素，唯独没有考虑到天气。

name: Why did Mr. Gilbert telephone Dr. Millington?
trans: 为什么吉尔伯特先生给米林顿医生打了电话？

name: While John Gilbert was in hospital,
trans: 在约翰·吉尔伯特住院期间，

name: he asked his doctor to tell him
trans: 他请求医生告诉他（具体需要知道的信息）。

name: whether his operation had been successful,
trans: 无论他的手术是否成功……

name: but the doctor refused to do so.
trans: 但是医生拒绝这样做。

name: The following day,
trans: 第二天，

name: the patient asked for a bedside telephone.
trans: 患者要求配备一台床边电话。

name: When he was alone,
trans: 当他独自一人时，

name: he telephoned the hospital exchange
trans: 他拨打了医院的电话总机。

name: and asked for Doctor Millington.
trans: 然后他请求见米林顿医生。

name: When the doctor answered the phone,
trans: 当医生接听电话时，

name: Mr. Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient,
trans: 吉尔伯特先生说，他正在询问关于某位病人的情况。

name: a Mr. John Gilbert.
trans: 一位名叫约翰·吉尔伯特的先生。

name: He asked if Mr. Gilbert's operation had been successful
trans: 他询问吉尔伯特先生的手术是否成功。

name: and the doctor told him that it had been.
trans: 医生告诉他，情况确实如此（即他所描述的情况确实发生过）。

name: He then asked when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to
trans: 他接着询问吉尔伯特先生什么时候可以被允许（做某事）。

name: go home and the doctor told him
trans: 他回到家后，医生告诉了他（一些情况或建议）。

name: that he would have to stay
trans: 这意味着他必须留下来。

name: in hosptial for another two weeks.
trans: 他还需要在医院住院两周。

name: Then Dr. Millington asked the caller
trans: 然后，米林顿博士询问了来电者。

name: if he was a relative of the patient.
trans: 如果他是患者的亲属的话……

name: 'No,' the patient answered,
trans: “不，”病人回答道。

name: 'I am Mr. John Gilbert.'
trans: 我是约翰·吉尔伯特先生。

name: Was Mrs. Rumbold a good companion at dinner?
trans: 兰博尔德夫人在晚餐时是个不错的交谈伙伴吗？

name: Last week at a dinner party,
trans: 上周在一个晚宴上，

name: the hostess asked me to sit next to Mrs. Rumbold.
trans: 女服务员让我坐在朗博尔德夫人旁边。

name: Mrs. Rumbold was a large,
trans: 朗博尔德太太身材魁梧……

name: unsmiling lady in a tight black dress.
trans: 那位面无笑容的女士穿着一件紧身的黑色连衣裙。

name: She did not even look up when I took my seat beside her.
trans: 当我坐在她旁边时，她甚至都没有抬头看我一眼。

name: Her eyes were fixed on her plate and in a short time,
trans: 她的目光紧紧盯着自己的盘子，不一会儿……

name: she was busy eating.
trans: 她当时正忙着吃饭。

name: I tried to make conversation.
trans: 我试着和他们交谈。

name: 'A new play is coming to "The Globe" soon,'
trans: 一部新剧很快将在“The Globe”剧院上演。

name: I said. 'Will you be seeing it?'
trans: 我说：“你会看到它吗？”

name: 'No,' she answered.
trans: “不，”她回答道。

name: 'Will you be spending your holidays abroad this year?' I asked.
trans: “今年你打算在国外度过假期吗？”我问道。

name: 'No,' she answered.
trans: “不，”她回答。

name: 'Will you be staying in England?' I asked.
trans: “那你会留在英国吗？”我又问。

name: 'No,' she answered.
trans: “也不，”她还是回答“不”。

name: In despair, I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner.
trans: 我有些绝望，便问她晚餐吃得怎么样。

name: 'Young man,' she answered,
trans: “年轻人，”她说道，

name: 'if you ate more and talked less, we would both enjoy our dinner!'
trans: “如果你多吃点、少说点话，我们俩的晚餐都会更愉快！”

name: What kind of shopping does the writer enjoy, do you think?
trans: 你觉得这位作家喜欢哪种类型的购物呢？
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: 'Do you call that a hat?' I said to my wife.
trans: “你那叫帽子吗？”我对我的妻子说道。
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: 'You needn't be so rude about it,'
trans: “你没必要这么无礼啊。”
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: my wife answered as she looked at herself in the mirror.
trans: 我妻子一边看着镜子中的自己，一边回答了我。
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: I sat down on one of those modern chairs with holes in it and waited.
trans: 我坐在那把带有孔洞的现代风格椅子上，然后等待着。
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: We had been in the hat shop for half an hour and my wife was still in front of the mirror.
trans: 我们在那家帽子店已经待了半个小时了，而我妻子仍然站在镜子前挑选帽子。
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: 'We mustn't buy things we don't need,' I remarked suddenly.
trans: “我们不应该购买那些我们不需要的东西，”我突然说道。
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: I regretted saying it almost at once.
trans: 我几乎立刻就后悔说了那句话。
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: 'You needn't have said that,' my wife answered.
trans: “你其实没必要那么说，”我的妻子回答道。
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: 'I needn't remind you of that terrible tie you bought yesterday.'
trans: “我其实没必要再提醒你昨天你买的那条糟糕的领带了。”
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: 'I find it beautiful,' I said. 'A man can never have too many ties.'
trans: “我觉得这很漂亮，”我说，“一个男人永远都不应该拥有太少的领带。”
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: 'And a woman can't have too many hats,' she answered.
trans: “而且，一个女人永远都不嫌帽子戴得太多，”她回答道。
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: Ten minutes later we walked out of the shop together.
trans: 十分钟后，我们一起走出了那家商店。
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: My wife was wearing a hat that looked like a lighthouse!
trans: 我妻子戴着一顶看起来像灯塔的帽子！
lesson: NCE2 · Do You Call That a Hat?

name: What happened when the snake charmer began to play jazz?
trans: 当那个耍蛇的人开始演奏爵士乐时，发生了什么？

name: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of old Delhi,
trans: 在我们沿着旧德里的一个市场走了很长一段路之后……

name: we stopped at a square to have a rest.
trans: 我们在一个广场上停下来休息。

name: After a time, we noticed a snake charmer with
trans: 过了一段时间，我们注意到有一个耍蛇的人……

name: two large baskets at the other side of the square,
trans: 在广场的另一边，有两个大篮子。

name: so we went to have a look at him.
trans: 于是我们就去看了他一眼（或者：我们去了看看他）。

name: As soon as he saw us,
trans: 他一看到我们，

name: he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins and opened one of the baskets.
trans: 他拿起一根长管子，管子上沾满了硬币，然后打开了其中一个篮子。

name: When he began to play a tune,
trans: 当他开始演奏一首曲子时，

name: we had our first glimpse of the snake.
trans: 我们第一次看到了那条蛇。

name: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
trans: 它从篮子里爬了出来，开始跟随管道的移动轨迹前进。

name: We were very much surprised when the snake charmer
trans: 当我们看到那个耍蛇的人时，我们感到非常惊讶。

name: suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
trans: 突然，音乐开始播放爵士乐和现代流行歌曲。

name: The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly.
trans: 然而，那条蛇仍然继续缓慢地“跳舞”。

name: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
trans: 显然，它根本分不清印度音乐和爵士乐的区别！

name: How was the plane able to clear the mountains?
trans: 这架飞机是如何成功飞越那些山脉的呢？

name: In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole,
trans: 1929年，在他飞越北极三年后……

name: the American explorer, R.E. Byrd,
trans: 美国探险家 R.E. 比尔德（R.E. Byrd）

name: successfully flew over the South Pole for the first time.
trans: 它首次成功飞越了南极。

name: Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a
trans: 不过，起初伯德和他的手下们确实成功夺取了某样东西（或：起初伯德和他的团队确实取得了一定的胜利/成果）。

name: great many photographs of the mountains that lay below,
trans: 大量的照片记录了下方那些山脉的景象。

name: they soon ran into serious trouble.
trans: 他们很快就遇到了严重的麻烦。

name: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
trans: 有那么一刻，人们确信他们的飞机将会坠毁。

name: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10, 000 feet.
trans: 只有当它上升到 10,000 英尺的高度时，才能翻越那些山脉。

name: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
trans: 伯德立刻命令他的手下扔出两个装满食物的重袋子。

name: The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
trans: 随后，飞机成功升空，并飞越了那些山脉，高度增加了 400 英尺。

name: Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away,
trans: 伯德现在知道，他一定能够到达距离他300英里远的南极。

name: for there were no more mountains in sight.
trans: 因为视线所及之处已经没有更多的山峰了。

name: The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
trans: 这架飞机能够毫不费力地飞越那些一望无际的白色平原。

name: How did Mrs. Sterling get her bag back?
trans: 斯特林夫人是怎么拿回她的包的？

name: Mrs. Anne Sterling did not think of the risk
trans: 安妮·斯特林夫人并没有考虑到其中的风险。

name: she was taking when she ran through a forest after two men.
trans: 她正在追赶那两个男人时，突然穿过了一片森林。

name: They had rushed up to her while she was having a picnic at the edge of a forest
trans: 当她在森林边缘野餐时，他们立刻跑向了她。

name: with her children and tried to steal her handbag.
trans: 她带着自己的孩子，试图偷她的手提包。

name: In the struggle, the strap broke and,
trans: 在挣扎的过程中，那根带子断了。

name: with the bag in their possession,
trans: 他们拿着那个包。

name: both men started running through the trees.
trans: 两名男子开始在树林中奔跑。

name: Mrs. Sterling got so angry that she ran after them.
trans: 斯特林太太气得冲了上去追赶他们。

name: She was soon out of breath,
trans: 她很快就气喘吁吁了。

name: but she continued to run.
trans: 但她还是继续奔跑着。

name: When she caught up with them,
trans: 当她追上他们时，

name: she saw that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag,
trans: 她看到他们已经坐下来，正在翻看包里的东西。

name: so she ran straight at them.
trans: 于是她直接朝他们冲了过去。

name: The men got such a fright that they dropped the bag and ran away.
trans: 那些男人吓得魂不附体，立刻扔下包逃跑了。

name: 'The strap needs mending,' said Mrs. Sterling later, 'but they did not steal anything.'
trans: “这条带子需要修理了，”斯特林夫人后来说道，“但他们什么也没偷。”

name: How did Sam get his money back?
trans: 萨姆是怎么把钱拿回来的？

name: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
trans: 整个村庄很快都知道有一大笔钱丢失了。

name: Sam Benton, the local butcher,
trans: 山姆·本顿，当地的肉铺老板……

name: had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
trans: 他在去邮局存钱的时候丢失了钱包。

name: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers,
trans: 萨姆确信那个钱包一定是被某个村民找到的。

name: but it was not returned to him.
trans: 但是，那个东西并没有被归还给他。

name: Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
trans: 三个月过去了，一天早晨，山姆发现他的钱包放在自家前门外面。

name: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost,
trans: 它被用报纸包了起来，里面装着他丢失的钱的一半。

name: together with a note which said:
trans: 还附有一张纸条，上面写着：

name: 'A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!'
trans: “他确实是个小偷，但只能算是个‘50%的小偷’罢了！”

name: Two months later,
trans: 两个月后，

name: some more money was sent to Sam with another note:
trans: 又有一些钱被寄给了萨姆，并附上了一张便条。

name: 'Only 25 per cent a thief now!'
trans: “现在只有25%的人是小偷了！”

name: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
trans: 随着时间的推移，山姆的所有钱都通过这种方式被还清了。

name: The last note said: 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
trans: 最后一张纸条上写着：“现在我100%是诚实的了！”

name: What did the man in this story do?
trans: 这个故事里的男人做了什么？

name: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport,
trans: 当一架从伦敦起飞的飞机抵达悉尼机场时，

name: workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes which contained clothing.
trans: 工人们开始卸下许多装有衣物的木箱。

name: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
trans: 没有人能够解释为什么其中一个箱子会异常地重。

name: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
trans: 突然，其中一个工人想到应该打开那个箱子。

name: He was astonished at what he found.
trans: 他对自己的发现感到非常惊讶。

name: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
trans: 一个男人躺在箱子里，而那个箱子放在一堆羊毛制品的上面。

name: He was so surprised at being discovered that he did not even try to run away.
trans: 他发现自己被发现了，惊讶得连逃跑的念头都没有。

name: After he was arrested,
trans: 在他被逮捕之后，

name: the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
trans: 那名男子承认在飞机离开伦敦之前躲在了那个箱子里。

name: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip,
trans: 他经历了一段漫长而令人不适的旅程。

name: for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
trans: 因为他已经被关在那个木箱里超过十八个小时了。

name: The man was ordered to pay ￡3, 500 for the cost of the trip.
trans: 这名男子被要求支付3,500英镑作为旅行的费用。

name: The normal price of a ticket is ￡2, 000!
trans: 而一张普通票的价格仅为2,000英镑！

name: What evidence is there of a ghost?
trans: 有什么证据表明有鬼存在呢？

name: A public house which was recently bought by Mr.Ian Thompson is up for sale.
trans: 一家最近被伊恩·汤普森先生购买的酒吧正在出售中。

name: Mr.Thompson is going to sell it because it is haunted.
trans: 汤普森先生打算卖掉那栋房子，因为据说那里有鬼魂出没。

name: He told me that he could not go to sleep one night
trans: 有一天晚上，他告诉我他无法入睡。

name: because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
trans: 因为他听到从酒吧里传来一阵奇怪的声音。

name: The next morning,
trans: 第二天早上，

name: he found that the doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved.
trans: 他发现门被椅子堵住了，家具也被挪动了。

name: Though Mr.Thompson had turned the lights off before he went to bed,
trans: 尽管汤普森先生在睡觉前已经关掉了灯，

name: they were on in the morning.
trans: 它们在早上就启动了（或运行了）。

name: He also said that he had found five empty whisky bottles
trans: 他还说，他发现了五个空威士忌酒瓶。

name: which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
trans: 那个鬼肯定是在前一晚喝掉了那些东西（指那些液体）。

name: When I suggested that some villagers must have come
trans: 当我提出“肯定有一些村民来过这里”这个想法时……

name: in for a free drink, Mr.Thompson shook his head.
trans: “想白喝一杯？那可不行，”汤普森先生摇了摇头。

name: The villagers have told him that
trans: 村民们告诉他：

name: they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
trans: “就算他把酒吧免费送出去，他们也不会接受的。”

name: Why did the writer become very worried?
trans: 为什么作者会变得非常担心呢？
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: Dentists always ask questions when it is impossible for you to answer.
trans: 牙医总是在你无法回答问题的时候提问。
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: My dentist had just pulled out one of my teeth and had told me to rest for a while.
trans: 我的牙医刚刚拔掉了我的一颗牙齿，然后让我休息一会儿。
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: I tried to say something,
trans: 我试图说些什么，
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: but my mouth was full of cotton wool.
trans: 但我的嘴里塞满了棉花。
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: He knew I collected match boxes and asked me whether my collection was growing.
trans: 他知道我喜欢收集火柴盒，便问我这个收藏是否还在继续增加。
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: He then asked me how my brother was and whether I liked my new job in London.
trans: 接着他又问我弟弟的情况，以及我是否喜欢在伦敦的新工作。
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: In answer to these questions I either nodded or made strange noises.
trans: 对于这些问题，我只能点头或者发出一些奇怪的声音作为回答。
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: Meanwhile, my tongue was busy searching out the hole where the tooth had been.
trans: 与此同时，我的舌头一直在寻找那颗牙齿曾经所在的位置。
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: I suddenly felt very worried, but could not say anything.
trans: 我突然感到非常担心，但却什么也说不出来。
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: When the dentist at last removed the cotton wool from my mouth,
trans: 直到牙医终于把嘴里的棉花取出来，
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: I was able to tell him that he had pulled out the wrong tooth.
trans: 我才告诉他，他拔错了牙齿。
lesson: NCE2 · Did You Want to Tell Me Something?

name: How did the dream end?
trans: 这个梦是怎么结束的？
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: Tired of sleeping on the floor,
trans: 受够了睡在地板上……
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: a young man in Teheran saved up for years to buy a real bed.
trans: 在德黑兰，一个年轻人为了买一张真正的床，攒了多年的钱。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: For the first time in his life,
trans: 他生平第一次……
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: he became the proud owner of a bed which had springs and a mattress.
trans: 他成为了一张配有弹簧和床垫的床的骄傲主人。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: Because the weather was very hot,
trans: 因为天气非常炎热，
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: he carried the bed on to the roof of his house.
trans: 他把那张床搬到了自己房子的屋顶上。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: He slept very well for the first two nights,
trans: 他在头两个晚上睡得非常好。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: but on the third night, a storm blew up.
trans: 但是到了第三天晚上，一场暴风雨突然降临了。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: A gust of wind swept the bed off the roof and sent it crashing into the courtyard below.
trans: 一阵风吹走了屋顶上的床，将其猛烈地抛落到下面的院子里。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: The young man did not wake up
trans: 那个年轻人没有醒来。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: until the bed had struck the ground.
trans: 直到床终于落地为止。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: Although the bed was smashed to pieces,
trans: 尽管床被砸得粉碎，
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: the man was miraculously unhurt.
trans: 那个人却奇迹般地毫发无伤。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: When he woke up, he was still on the mattress.
trans: 当他醒来时，发现自己仍然躺在床垫上。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: Glancing at the bits of wood and metal that lay around him,
trans: 看着周围散落的木屑和金属碎片，
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: the man sadly picked up the mattress and carried it into his house.
trans: 他无奈地捡起床垫，把它搬回了家里。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: After he had put it on the floor,
trans: 把床垫放在地板上后，
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: he promptly went to sleep again.
trans: 他立刻又睡着了。
lesson: NCE2 · The End of a Dream

name: Why did the writer not get off the bus at Woodford Green?
trans: 为什么作者没有在伍德福德格林（Woodford Green）下车呢？

name: I love travelling in the country,
trans: 我喜欢在乡村旅行。

name: but I don't like losing my way.
trans: 但我不喜欢迷路。

name: I went on an excursion recently,
trans: 我最近去参加了一次短途旅行。

name: but my trip took me longer than I expected.
trans: 但是我的旅行花费的时间比我预期的要长。

name: 'I'm going to Woodford Green,'
trans: “我要去伍德福德格林。”

name: I said to the conductor as I got on the bus,
trans: 当我登上公交车时，我对售票员说：

name: 'but I don't know where it is.'
trans: “但我不知道它在哪里。”

name: 'I'll tell you where to get off.' answered the conductor.
trans: “我会告诉你该在哪里下车。”列车员回答道。

name: I sat in the front of the bus to get a good view of the countryside.
trans: 我坐在公交车的前排，以便能更好地欣赏乡村的景色。

name: After some time, the bus stopped.
trans: 过了一段时间，公交车停了下来。

name: Looking round, I realized with a shock that I was the only passenger left on the bus.
trans: 环顾四周后，我震惊地发现自己是公交车上唯一剩下的乘客。

name: 'You'll have to get off here,'
trans: “你得从这里下去。”

name: the conductor said. 'This is as far as we go.'
trans: 指挥官说：“我们就到此为止了。”

name: 'Is this Woodford Green?' I asked.
trans: “这是伍德福德格林（Woodford Green）吗？”我问道。

name: 'Oh dear,' said the conductor suddenly.
trans: “哦，天哪，”列车长突然说道。

name: 'I forgot to put you off.'
trans: “我忘了让你推迟（某个计划）。”

name: 'It doesn't matter,' I said. 'I'll get off here.'
trans: “没关系，”我说，“我会离开这里的。”

name: 'We're going back now,' said the conductor.
trans: “我们现在要回去了，”列车长说道。

name: 'Well, in that case,
trans: “那么，在那种情况下……”

name: I prefer to stay on the bus,' I answered.
trans: “我更愿意待在公交车上，”我回答道。

name: Why did Hugh's diet not work?
trans: 为什么休的节食计划没有效果呢？

name: My friend, Hugh, has always been fat,
trans: 我的朋友休一直都很胖。

name: but things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet.
trans: 但最近情况变得非常糟糕，以至于他决定开始节食。

name: He began his diet a week ago.
trans: 他一周前开始节食了。

name: First of all, he wrote out a long list of all the foods which were forbidden.
trans: 首先，他列出了一份长长的清单，上面列出了所有被禁止食用的食物。

name: The list included most of the things Hugh loves:
trans: 这份清单上列出了休最喜欢的大多数东西。

name: butter, potatoes, rice, beer, milk, chocolate, and sweets.
trans: 黄油、土豆、米饭、啤酒、牛奶、巧克力和甜点。

name: Yesterday I paid him a visit.
trans: 昨天我去拜访了他。

name: I rang the bell and was not surprised to see that Hugh was still as fat as ever.
trans: 我按响了门铃，看到休还是和以前一样胖，并没有感到惊讶。

name: He led me into his room and hurriedly hid a large parcel under his desk.
trans: 他把我带进了他的房间，然后匆忙地把一个大包裹藏在了桌子下面。

name: It was obvious that he was very embarrassed.
trans: 很明显，他感到非常尴尬。

name: When I asked him what he was doing,
trans: 当我问他正在做什么时，

name: he smiled guiltily and then put the parcel on the desk.
trans: 他带着内疚的笑容，把包裹放在了桌子上。

name: He explained that his diet was so strict that he had to reward himself occasionally.
trans: 他解释说，他的饮食控制非常严格，因此偶尔需要奖励自己一下。

name: Then he showed me the contents of the parcel.
trans: 然后他向我展示了包裹里的物品。

name: It contained five large bars of chocolate and three bags of sweets!
trans: 里面装有五块大巧克力和三袋糖果！

name: What is the writer's carpet made of?
trans: 作者的“地毯”（这里可能指作者的办公环境或工作场所）是由什么材料制成的呢？

name: We have just moved into a new house and I have been working hard all morning.
trans: 我们刚搬进了一栋新房子，我一整个早上都在努力工作。

name: I have been trying to get my new room in order.
trans: 我一直在努力把我的新房间整理得井井有条。

name: This has not been easy because I own over a thousand books.
trans: 这并不容易，因为我有超过一千本书。

name: To make matters worse,
trans: 更糟糕的是……

name: the room is rather small,
trans: 这个房间相当小。

name: so I have temporarily put my books on the floor.
trans: 所以我暂时把我的书放在了地板上。

name: At the moment, they cover every inch of floor space
trans: 目前，它们已经覆盖了每一寸的地面空间。

name: and I actually have to walk on them to get in or out of the room.
trans: 实际上，我必须踩在这些东西上才能进入或离开房间。

name: A short while ago, my sister helped me to carry one of my old bookcases up the stairs.
trans: 不久前，我的姐姐帮我把其中一个旧书柜搬上了楼梯。

name: She went into my room and got a big surprise when she saw all those books on the floor.
trans: 她走进我的房间，看到地板上堆满了书，顿时感到非常惊讶。

name: 'This is the prettiest carpet I have ever seen,' she said.
trans: “这是我见过最漂亮的地毯了，”她说。

name: She gazed at it for some time then added,
trans: 她凝视着它一会儿，然后补充道：

name: 'You don't need bookcases at all.
trans: “你根本不需要书架。

name: You can sit here in your spare time and read the carpet!'
trans: 你可以在空闲时间坐在这里，直接在地毯上阅读！”

name: What caused the fire?
trans: 是什么导致了这场火灾？

name: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.
trans: 消防员们终于扑灭了加利福尼亚州的那场大规模森林火灾。

name: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
trans: 从那以后，他们一直在试图查明火灾的起因。

name: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
trans: 森林火灾通常是由碎玻璃或人们随意丢弃的烟头引起的。

name: Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully,
trans: 昨天，消防员们仔细地检查了那片地面。

name: but were not able to find any broken glass.
trans: 但我们没有发现任何碎玻璃。

name: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
trans: 他们也非常确定，火灾并不是由烟头引起的。

name: This morning, however, a firemen accidentally discovered the cause.
trans: 然而，今天早上，消防员们意外地发现了事故的原因。

name: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16, 000-volt power line.
trans: 他发现了一条蛇的残骸，那条蛇缠绕在一条电压为16,000伏的电力线上的电线上。

name: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
trans: 通过这种方式，他终于解开了这个谜团。

name: The explanation was simple but very unusual.
trans: 这个解释很简单，但却非常不寻常。

name: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
trans: 一只鸟从地上抓起了那条蛇，然后把它扔到了电线上。

name: The snake then wound itself round the wires.
trans: 然后，那条蛇缠住了那些电线。

name: When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
trans: 当它这样做的时候，火花掉到了地上，立刻引发了火灾。

name: What two interruptions did the writer have?
trans: 作者遇到了哪两种干扰（或中断）？

name: After breakfast, I sent the children to school and then I went to the shops.
trans: 早餐后，我送孩子们去了学校，然后去了商店。

name: It was still early when I returned home.
trans: 当我回到家时，时间还早。

name: The children were at school, my husband was at work and the house was quiet.
trans: 孩子们都在学校，我丈夫也在上班，家里一片安静。

name: So I decided to make some meat pies.
trans: 所以我决定做一些肉馅派。

name: In a short time I was busy mixing butter
trans: 没过多久，我就忙着搅拌黄油了。

name: and flour and my hands were soon covered with sticky pastry.
trans: 然后我加入了面粉，很快我的双手就沾满了粘糊糊的面团。

name: At exactly that moment, the telephone rang.
trans: 就在那一刻，电话响了。

name: Nothing could have been more annoying.
trans: 没有什么比这更让人恼火了。

name: I picked up the receiver between two sticky fingers and was dismayed when I recognized the voice of Helen Bates.
trans: 我小心翼翼地拿起听筒（尽管手指有些湿滑），当听到海伦·贝茨的声音时，我感到非常失望。

name: It took me ten minutes to persuade her to ring back later. At last I hung up the receiver.
trans: 我花了十分钟的时间才说服她稍后回电话。最后，我终于挂断了电话。

name: What a mess! There was pastry on my fingers, on the telephone, and on the doorknobs.
trans: 真是一团糟！我的手指上、电话上，还有门把手上都沾满了糕点碎屑。

name: I had no sooner got back to the kitchen than the doorbell rang loud enough to wake the dead.
trans: 我刚回到厨房，门铃就响得震天响，仿佛连死人都会被吵醒。

name: This time it was the postman and he wanted me to sign for a registered letter!
trans: 这次来的是邮递员，他让我签收一封挂号信！

name: What did the team find?
trans: 团队发现了什么？

name: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
trans: 最近，我梦想着找到失落的宝藏，这个梦想几乎成真了。

name: A new machine called 'The Revealer' has been invented
trans: 一种名为“The Revealer”的新机器已经被发明出来了。

name: and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
trans: 它已被用于探测埋藏在地下的黄金。

name: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where--it is said--pirates used to hide gold.
trans: 这台机器被用于海边附近的一个洞穴中；据说，海盗们过去常常在那里藏匿黄金。

name: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
trans: 海盗们经常把黄金埋藏在洞穴里，但后来却没能把那些黄金取出来。

name: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
trans: 带着这台新机器，一支搜寻队进入了洞穴，希望能找到埋藏的宝藏。

name: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
trans: 当党的领导人正在检查洞穴入口附近的土壤时，机器显示地下有黄金。

name: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
trans: 非常兴奋，大家一起挖了一个两英尺深的坑。

name: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
trans: 他们终于找到了一枚小金币，但这枚金币几乎毫无价值。

name: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
trans: 随后，他们彻底搜查了整个洞穴，但除了一个空铁皮箱外什么也没找到。

name: In spite of this, many people are confident that 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value fairly soon.
trans: 尽管如此，许多人仍然相信，“揭示者”很快就会揭示出一些有价值的信息。

name: How fast did the winning car go?
trans: 那辆获胜的汽车速度有多快？

name: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
trans: 每年都会举办一场专为老爷车设计的比赛。

name: A lot of cars entered for this race last year and there was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
trans: 去年有大量的汽车参加了这场比赛，比赛开始前大家都充满了兴奋之情。

name: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
trans: 其中最引人注目的汽车之一是劳斯莱斯银魅（Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost）。

name: The most unusual car was a Benz which had only three wheels.
trans: 最不寻常的汽车是一辆只有三个轮子的奔驰（Benz）汽车。

name: Built in 1885, it was the oldest car taking part.
trans: 这辆汽车建于1885年，是参赛车辆中历史最悠久的一辆。

name: After a great many loud explosions, the race began.
trans: 在许多巨大的爆炸声之后，比赛终于开始了。

name: Many of the cars broke down on the course and some drivers spent more time under their cars than in them!
trans: 许多汽车在赛道上发生了故障；有些司机花在检查汽车故障上的时间，甚至比他们实际驾驶汽车的时间还要长！

name: A few cars, however, completed the race.
trans: 然而，还是有几辆车完成了比赛。

name: The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour -- much faster than any of its rivals.
trans: 获胜的汽车达到了每小时40英里的速度——这比它的所有竞争对手都要快得多。

name: It sped downhill at the end of the race and its driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it.
trans: 在比赛结束时，这辆车飞快地冲下了山坡，它的驾驶员费了很大劲才设法让它停下来。

name: The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure.
trans: 这场比赛给大家带来了极大的乐趣。

name: It was very different from modern car races but no less exciting.
trans: 这与现代的汽车比赛非常不同，但同样令人兴奋。

name: Did the woman get what she wanted?
trans: 那个女人得到了她想要的东西吗？
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: A woman in jeans stood at the window of an expensive shop.
trans: 一个穿着牛仔裤的女人站在一家高档商店的窗前。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: Though she hesitated for a moment,
trans: 虽然她犹豫了一会儿，
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: she finally went in and asked to see a dress that was in the window.
trans: 她终于走进店里，要求试穿那件展示在橱窗里的连衣裙。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: The assistant who served her did not like the way she was dressed.
trans: 为她服务的助手不喜欢她的穿着方式。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: Glancing at her scornfully, he told her that the dress was sold.
trans: 他轻蔑地瞥了她一眼，然后告诉她那条裙子已经卖掉了。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: The woman walked out of the shop angrily and decided to punish the assistant next day.
trans: 那个女人愤怒地走出了商店，并决定第二天要惩罚那个店员。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: She returned to the shop the following morning dressed in a fur coat,
trans: 第二天早上，她穿着一件皮草大衣回到了店里。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: with a handbag in one hand and a long umbrella in the other.
trans: 一只手拿着手提包，另一只手拿着一把长伞。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: After seeking out the rude assistant,
trans: 在找到了那个粗鲁的助理之后，
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: she asked for the same dress.
trans: 她又要求买同一条裙子。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: Not realizing who she was, the assistant was eager to serve her this time.
trans: 由于没有认出她的身份，这次服务员非常热情地想要为她提供服务。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: With great difficulty, he climbed into the shop window to get the dress.
trans: 他费了很大的劲才爬进商店的橱窗里，去拿那条裙子。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: As soon as she saw it, the woman said she did not like it.
trans: 她一看到那个东西，就说她不喜欢它。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: She enjoyed herself making the assistant bring almost everything in the window
trans: 她很享受让助手把橱窗里几乎所有的商品都拿出来的过程。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: before finally buying the dress she had first asked for.
trans: 在最终购买那条她最初要求的裙子之前，她先询问了相关细节（比如尺寸、颜色等）。
lesson: NCE2 · Can I Help You, Madam?

name: Why does the vicar refuse to cut down the tree?
trans: 为什么牧师拒绝砍倒那棵树呢？

name: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'.
trans: 据说，弗林利这个小村庄里有一棵“被诅咒的树”。

name: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper,
trans: 因为这棵树被报纸报道过了，

name: the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased.
trans: 弗林利的访客数量现在已经增加了。

name: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago, but it is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
trans: 这棵树是在五十年前种在教堂附近的，但直到最近几年，它才获得了“邪恶”的名声。

name: It is said that if anyone touches the tree, he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die.
trans: 据说，如果有人触碰这棵树，就会遭遇厄运；如果他摘下一片叶子，就会死亡。

name: Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims.
trans: 许多村民认为，这棵树已经夺去了不少人的生命（或者说：这棵树已经导致了许多人死亡）。

name: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down, but so far he has refused.
trans: 牧师被要求把那棵树砍掉，但他至今仍然拒绝这样做。

name: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income,
trans: 他指出，这棵树是收入的一个可靠来源。

name: as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
trans: 因为游客们从全国各地纷纷前来参观它。

name: In spite of all that has been said,
trans: 尽管已经说了这么多，

name: the tourists have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree-trunk.
trans: 游客们一直在摘树叶，并在树干上刻下自己的名字。

name: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
trans: 到目前为止，他们当中还没有一个人突然死亡！

name: Why did Rex run away?
trans: 为什么雷克斯会逃跑呢？

name: Our dog, Rex, used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
trans: 我们的狗雷克斯过去常常坐在前门外面，然后吠叫。

name: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.
trans: 每次他想进入花园时，都会不停地吠叫，直到有人打开大门。

name: As the neighbours complained of the noise, my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
trans: 由于邻居们对噪音表示不满，我丈夫花了数周时间训练这只狗：让它用爪子按住门锁，从而自己能够进入家门。

name: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.
trans: 雷克斯很快就成为了打开那扇门的专家。

name: However, when I was going out shopping last week, I noticed him in the garden near the gate.
trans: 然而，上周我去购物的时候，我在大门附近的花园里看到了他。

name: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out!
trans: 这次他大声吠叫，就是为了有人能放他出去！

name: Since then, he has developed another bad habit.
trans: 从那以后，他又养成了一个坏习惯。

name: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.
trans: 他一从外面打开大门，就走进花园，然后等待大门关上。

name: Then he sits and barks until someone lets him out.
trans: 然后他就坐着，不停地叫，直到有人放他出去。

name: After this he immediately lets himself in and begins barking again.
trans: 之后，他立刻自己进了门，又开始吠叫起来。

name: Yesterday my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed we have not seen him since.
trans: 昨天我丈夫把那道门拆掉了，结果雷克斯（Rex）非常生气，从那以后我们就再也没见过它了。

name: Does what Madam Bellinsky said come true?
trans: 贝尔林斯基夫人所说的话会成真吗？

name: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
trans: 在一个乡村集市上，我决定去拜访一位名叫贝林斯基夫人的算命师。

name: I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
trans: 我走进她的帐篷，她让我坐下。

name: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball and said:
trans: 在我给了她一些钱之后，她看了看那个水晶球，然后说道：

name: 'A relation of yours is coming to see you.
trans: 你的一个亲戚要来看你。

name: She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
trans: 她将于今晚到达，并打算在这里待上几天。

name: The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
trans: 你一离开这个帐篷，就会遇到一个巨大的惊喜。

name: A woman you know well will rush towards you.
trans: 一个你非常熟悉的女人会冲向你。

name: She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place. That is all.'
trans: 她会和你说话，然后带你离开这个地方。就这些。

name: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
trans: 我一走到外面，就立刻把贝林斯基夫人忘得一干二净了，因为我的妻子立刻朝我跑了过来。

name: 'Where have you been hiding?' she asked impatiently.
trans: “你一直躲在哪里？”她不耐烦地问道。

name: 'Your sister will be here in less than an hour and we must be at the station to meet her. We are late already.'
trans: 你妹妹将在一小时内到达，我们必须赶到车站去接她。我们已经迟到了。

name: As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
trans: 当她走开时，我跟在她后面离开了集市。

name: What is the special importance of a telescope in space?
trans: 望远镜在太空中具有怎样的特殊重要性？

name: The Hubble telescope was launched into
trans: 哈勃望远镜被发射到了太空中。

name: space by NASA on April 20, 1990 at a cost of over a billion dollars.
trans: 这艘航天器是由美国国家航空航天局（NASA）于1990年4月20日发射的，耗资超过10亿美元。

name: Right from the start there was trouble with the Hubble.
trans: 从一开始，哈勃望远镜就遇到了各种问题（即：从它被发射使用的那一刻起，就一直存在故障或运行不稳定等问题）。

name: The pictures it sent us were very disappointing because its main mirror was faulty!
trans: 它发给我们的照片非常令人失望，因为它的主镜有问题（即主镜无法正常工作）。

name: NASA is now going to put the telescope right,
trans: NASA现在将把望远镜调整到正确的位置。

name: so it will soon be sending up four astronauts to repair it.
trans: 因此，他们很快就会派遣四名宇航员去修理它。

name: The shuttle Endeavour will be taking the astronauts to the Hubble.
trans: “奋进号”航天飞机将把宇航员送往哈勃太空望远镜所在的位置。

name: A robot-arm from the Endeavour will grab the telescope and hold it while the astronauts make the necessary repairs.
trans: “奋进号”航天飞机的机械臂会抓取这台望远镜，并在宇航员进行必要的维修工作时将其固定住。

name: Of course, the Hubble is above the earth's atmosphere,
trans: 当然，哈勃望远镜位于地球大气层之外。

name: so it will soon be sending us the clearest pictures of the stars and distant galaxies that we have ever seen.
trans: 因此，它很快就会向我们发送迄今为止最清晰的恒星和遥远星系的图像。

name: The Hubble will tell us a great deal about the age and size of the universe.
trans: 哈勃望远镜将帮助我们了解宇宙的年龄和规模。

name: By the time you read this, the Hubble's eagle eye will have sent us thousands and thousands of wonderful pictures.
trans: 等到你读到这封信的时候，哈勃望远镜那“鹰一般的目光”已经为我们传回了成千上万张精彩的图片了。

name: What was the danger to the villages after the fire?
trans: 火灾过后，村庄们面临着哪些危险？

name: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks before they could get it under control.
trans: 消防员们与这场森林火灾抗争了近三周，才终于将其控制住。
