name: A short time before, great trees had covered the countryside for miles around.
trans: 就在不久之前，这片乡村的周围几英里范围内，都长满了高大的树木。

name: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground over the desolate hills.
trans: 此刻，烟雾仍从那片荒凉山丘上温暖的地面中升起。

name: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction,
trans: 冬天即将来临，那些山丘似乎随时都有可能摧毁周围的村庄。

name: for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil but would cause serious floods as well.
trans: 因为大雨不仅会冲走土壤，还会引发严重的洪水。

name: When the fire had at last been put out,
trans: 当大火终于被扑灭后，

name: the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed which would grow quickly.
trans: 森林管理部门订购了几吨一种特殊的草籽，这种草籽生长速度非常快。

name: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
trans: 这些种子被飞机大量喷洒到地面上。

name: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
trans: 这些飞机已经在进行播种作业近一个月了，就在这时，雨开始下了。

name: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
trans: 然而，到那时为止，草已经在许多地方生根发芽了。

name: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries,
trans: 取而代之的是那些已经在那里生长了几个世纪的参天大树。

name: patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
trans: 在烧焦的土壤中，开始出现了一小块块绿色的斑点。

name: Why did Jenny want to leave the wedding reception?
trans: 为什么珍妮想离开婚礼现场呢？

name: Jeremy Hampden has a large circle of friends and is very popular at parties.
trans: 杰里米·汉普登拥有很多朋友，在聚会上非常受欢迎。

name: Everybody admires him for his great sense of humour--everybody, that is, except his six-year-old daughter, Jenny.
trans: 大家都很欣赏他的幽默感——当然，除了他六岁的女儿珍妮之外。

name: Recently, one of Jeremy's closest friends asked him to make a speech at a wedding reception.
trans: 最近，杰里米的一位密友请求他在一场婚礼招待会上发表演讲。

name: This is the sort of thing that Jeremy loves.
trans: 这正是杰里米喜欢的东西。

name: He prepared the speech carefully and went to the wedding with Jenny.
trans: 他仔细准备了演讲稿，然后和珍妮一起参加了婚礼。

name: He had included a large number of funny stories in the speech and, of course, it was a great success.
trans: 他在演讲中穿插了许多有趣的故事，当然，这次演讲非常成功。

name: As soon as he had finished Jenny told him she wanted to go home.
trans: 他刚说完，珍妮就告诉他她想回家了。

name: Jeremy was a little disappointed by this but he did as his daughter asked.
trans: 杰里米对此感到有些失望，但他还是按照女儿的要求做了。

name: On the way home, he asked Jenny if she had enjoyed the speech.
trans: 在回家的路上，他问珍妮是否喜欢那场演讲。

name: To his surprise she said she hadn't.
trans: 令他惊讶的是，她说她并没有（做某件事）。

name: Jeremy asked her why this was so and she told him that she did not like to see so many people laughing at him!
trans: 杰里米问她为什么会有这样的反应，她回答说她不喜欢看到那么多人嘲笑他！

name: Why was the first tunnel not completed?
trans: 为什么第一条隧道没有完成呢？

name: In 1858, a French engineer, Aime Thome de Gamond,
trans: 1858年，一位名叫艾姆·托姆·德·加蒙（Aime Thome de Gamond）的法国工程师……

name: arrived in England with a plan for a 21-mile tunnel under the English Channel.
trans: 他抵达英格兰后，便制定了一个在英吉利海峡下建造一条长达21英里隧道的计划。

name: He said that it would be possible to build a platform in the centre of the Channel.
trans: 他说，在英吉利海峡中央建造一个平台是可行的。

name: This platform would serve as a port and a railway station.
trans: 这个平台将同时充当港口和火车站的功能。

name: The tunnel would be well-ventilated if tall chimneys were built above sea level.
trans: 如果在海平面上方建造高耸的烟囱，这条隧道将会拥有良好的通风条件。

name: In 1860, a better plan was put forward by an Englishman, William Low.
trans: 1860年，一位名叫威廉·洛（William Low）的英国人提出了一个更完善的方案。

name: He suggested that a double railway-tunnel should be built.
trans: 他建议建造一条双线铁路隧道。

name: This would solve the problem of ventilation for if a train entered this tunnel, it would draw in fresh air behind it.
trans: 这可以解决通风问题：当火车进入这条隧道时，它会将新鲜的空气带入隧道内部。

name: Forty-two years later a tunnel was actually begun.
trans: 四十二年后，人们终于开始修建这条隧道了。

name: If, at the time, the British had not feared invasion, it would have been completed.
trans: 如果当时英国人不担心遭到入侵的话，这项工程就会完成了。

name: The world had to wait almost another 100 years for the Channel Tunnel.
trans: 世界又等待了近100年，才看到了英法海底隧道的建成。

name: It was officially opened on March 7, 1994, finally connecting Britain to the European continent.
trans: 它于1994年3月7日正式启用，终于将英国与欧洲大陆连接了起来。

name: Why did the police have to push Jumbo off the main street?
trans: 为什么警察不得不把 Jumbo 从主街上推走？

name: Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children's hospital.
trans: 去年圣诞节，马戏团老板吉米·盖茨决定把一些礼物送到儿童医院去。

name: Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a 'guard of honour' of six pretty girls,
trans: 他装扮成圣诞老人，由六位漂亮的女孩组成的“仪仗队”陪同着他。

name: he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
trans: 他骑着一只名叫“Jumbo”的小象，沿着城市的主街道出发了。

name: He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
trans: 他本应该知道，警察绝不会允许这种事情发生的。

name: A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
trans: 一名警察走过来对吉米说：“你应该走小路，因为‘Jumbo’正在阻碍交通。”

name: Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move.
trans: 虽然吉米立刻同意出发了，但“詹博”（Jumbo）却拒绝移动。

name: Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
trans: 十五名警察费了很大劲才把他从主街上弄走。

name: The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused.
trans: 警察们遇到了不少困难，不过他们觉得这件事非常有趣（或者说：虽然过程很艰难，但他们觉得这件事很有趣）。

name: 'Jumbo must weigh a few tons,' said a policeman afterwards,
trans: “那头‘庞然大物’肯定有好几吨重，”一名警察事后说道。

name: 'so it was fortunate that we didn't have to carry him.
trans: “所以我们很幸运，不必背着他（或：不必照顾他）。”

name: Of course, we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.'
trans: 当然，我们应该逮捕他，但由于他的犯罪记录良好，这次我们就放他一马吧。

name: What was 'sweet as honey' and why?
trans: 什么是“甜如蜜”的东西？为什么这么说呢？

name: In 1963 a Lancaster bomber crashed on Wallis Island,
trans: 1963年，一架兰开斯特轰炸机在沃利斯岛上坠毁了。

name: a remote place in the South Pacific, a long way west of Samoa.
trans: 一个位于南太平洋的偏远地区，距离萨摩亚以西很远。

name: The plane wasn't too badly damaged,
trans: 飞机的损坏程度并不严重。

name: but over the years the crash was forgotten and the wreck remained undisturbed.
trans: 然而，随着时间的推移，那场车祸被人们遗忘了，事故现场也一直保持着原样，未被任何人触动或破坏。

name: Then in 1989, twenty-six years after the crash, the plane was accidentally rediscovered in an aerial survey of the island.
trans: 然后在1989年，也就是飞机失事26年后，这架飞机在一次对该岛屿的航空勘测中被意外重新发现了。

name: By this time, a Lancaster bomber in reasonable condition was rare and worth rescuing.
trans: 到了这个时候，状况还算良好的兰开斯特轰炸机已经非常稀少了，因此它们自然值得被抢救下来。

name: The French authorities had the plane packaged and moved in parts back to France.
trans: 法国当局将这架飞机拆解成若干部分，并将其运回了法国。

name: Now a group of enthusiasts are going to have the plane restored.
trans: 现在，一群爱好者正着手修复这架飞机。

name: It has four Rolls-Royce Merlin engines but the group will need to have only three of them rebuilt.
trans: 这架飞机配备了四台罗尔斯-罗伊斯“梅林”（Rolls-Royce Merlin）发动机，不过该集团实际上只需要对其中三台进行翻新或维修。

name: Imagine their surprise and delight when they broke open the packing cases
trans: 想象一下，当他们打开包装箱时，他们的惊讶和喜悦之情吧！

name: and found that the fourth engine was sweet as honey--still in perfect condition.
trans: 结果发现，第四台发动机状况非常好，依然处于完美的使用状态。

name: A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive and it was totally preserved in beeswax!
trans: 一群蜜蜂将那台发动机改造成了一个蜂巢，并且整个发动机都被完美地保存在了蜂蜡之中！

name: Why does Tazieff risk his life like this?
trans: 为什么塔齐夫要这样冒生命危险呢？

name: Haroun Tazieff, the Polish scientist, has spent his lifetime studying active volcanoes and deep caves in all parts of the world.
trans: 波兰科学家哈鲁恩·塔齐夫（Haroun Tazieff）毕生致力于研究世界各地的活火山和深洞穴。

name: In 1948, he went to Lake Kivu in the Congo to observe a new volcano which he later named Kituro.
trans: 1948年，他前往刚果的基伍湖（Lake Kivu），观察一座新发现的火山，并将其命名为“基图罗”（Kituro）。

name: Tazieff was able to set up his camp very close to the volcano while it was erupting violently.
trans: 塔齐夫能够在火山剧烈喷发的时候，将他的营地搭建得离火山非常近。

name: Though he managed to take a number of brilliant photographs, he could not stay near the volcano for very long.
trans: 尽管他拍到了许多精彩的照片，但他却无法在火山附近停留太久。

name: He noticed that a river of liquid rock was coming towards him.
trans: 他注意到一股由熔岩组成的“液体岩流”正朝他袭来。

name: It threatened to surround him completely, but Tazieff managed to escape just in time.
trans: 它威胁要完全包围他，但塔齐耶夫及时逃脱了。

name: He waited until the volcano became quiet and he was able to return two days later.
trans: 他一直等到火山停止喷发，两天后才得以返回。

name: This time, he managed to climb into the mouth of Kituro so that he could take photographs and measure temperatures.
trans: 这一次，他成功爬进了 Kituro 的“嘴巴”里，以便进行拍照和测量温度。

name: Tazieff has often risked his life in this way.
trans: 塔齐夫经常以这种方式冒着生命危险。

name: He has been able to tell us more about active volcanoes than any man alive.
trans: 他比在世的任何人都更了解活火山的相关情况，能够向我们提供更多关于活火山的详细信息。

name: Why did Elizabeth tell Nigel that she was going to the dentist?
trans: 为什么伊丽莎白告诉尼格尔她要去牙医那里？

name: I crossed the street to avoid meeting him but he saw me and came running towards me.
trans: 我穿过马路想避开他，但他看到了我，然后跑了过来。

name: It was no use pretending that I had not seen him, so I waved to him.
trans: 假装没看见他是没用的，所以我向他挥了挥手。

name: I never enjoy meeting Nigel Dykes.
trans: 我从来都不喜欢见到尼格尔·戴克斯。

name: He never has anything to do.
trans: 他总是无所事事，闲得无聊。

name: No matter how busy you are, he always insists on coming with you.
trans: 无论你有多忙，他总是坚持要跟着你。

name: I had to think of a way of preventing him from following me around all morning.
trans: 我得想办法阻止他一整个早上都跟着我。

name: 'Hello, Nigel,' I said 'Fancy meeting you here!'
trans: “你好，尼格尔，”我说，“真没想到在这里遇见你！”

name: 'Hi, Elizabeth,' Nigel answered. 'I was just wondering how to spend the morning--until I saw you.
trans: “嗨，伊丽莎白，”尼格尔回答，“我正想着今天早上该做什么呢——直到我看到了你。

name: You're not busy doing anything, are you?'
trans: 你没什么事情要做吧？”

name: 'No, not at all,' I answered. 'I'm going to...'
trans: “没有，”我说，“我正要去……”

name: 'Would you mind my coming with you?' he asked, before I had finished speaking.
trans: “你介意我陪你一起去吗？”他还没等我说完就问了。

name: 'Not at all,' I lied, 'but I'm going to the dentist.'
trans: “一点也不，”我撒了个谎，“不过我确实要去看牙医。”

name: 'Then I'll come with you,' he answered.
trans: “那我就陪你一起去吧。”他回答道。

name: 'There's always plenty to read in the waiting room!'
trans: “候诊室里总是有很多书可以读的！”

name: Do you think that the writer passed his driving test? Why?
trans: 你认为那位作者通过了驾驶考试吗？为什么？

name: I was being tested for a driving licence for the third time.
trans: 这是我第三次参加驾照考试了。

name: I had been asked to drive in heavy traffic and had done so successfully.
trans: 我曾被要求在繁忙的交通中驾驶，而且我也成功完成了这项任务。

name: After having been instructed to drive out of town, I began to acquire confidence.
trans: 在接到“开车离开城镇”的指令后，我逐渐恢复了信心。

name: Sure that I had passed, I was almost beginning to enjoy my test.
trans: 当我确定自己已经通过了考试后，我甚至开始享受这个考试过程了。

name: The examiner must have been pleased with my performance, for he smiled and said, 'Just one more thing Mr. Eames.
trans: 考官一定对我的表现很满意，因为他微笑着对我说：“还有一件事，埃姆斯先生。”

name: Let us suppose that a child suddenly crosses the road in front of you.
trans: 假设突然有一个孩子在你面前横穿马路。

name: As soon as I tap on the window, you must stop within five feet.'
trans: “我一碰到窗户，你就必须在五英尺范围内停下来。”

name: I continued driving and after some time, the examiner tapped loudly.
trans: 我继续开车，过了一会儿，考官突然大声敲了敲车窗。

name: Though the sound could be heard clearly, it took me a long time to react.
trans: 虽然那个声音听得非常清楚，但我还是花了很长时间才做出反应。

name: I suddenly pressed the brake pedal hard and we were both thrown forward.
trans: 我突然猛踩刹车，结果我们俩都被向前甩了出去。

name: The examiner looked at me sadly.
trans: 考官悲伤地看着我。

name: 'Mr. Eames,' he said, in a mournful voice, 'you have just killed that child!'
trans: “埃姆斯先生，”他带着悲伤的声音说道，“您刚刚害死了那个孩子！”

name: How was the drunk removed from the ring?
trans: 那个醉汉是如何被从斗牛场里带走的呢？

name: During a bullfight, a drunk suddenly wandered into the middle of the ring.
trans: 在一场斗牛比赛中，一个醉汉突然走进了斗牛场的中央。

name: The crowd began to shout, but the drunk was unaware of the danger.
trans: 人群开始大声呼喊，但醉汉并没有意识到危险。

name: The bull was busy with the matador at the time,
trans: 当时公牛正与斗牛士搏斗，

name: but it suddenly caught sight of the drunk who was shouting rude remarks and waving a red cap.
trans: 突然它注意到了那个醉汉——醉汉正在大声说脏话，并挥舞着一顶红色帽子。

name: Apparently sensitive to criticism,
trans: 显然，公牛对别人的批评非常敏感，

name: the bull forgot all about the matador and charged at the drunk.
trans: 它立刻忘记了斗牛士的存在，冲向了醉汉。

name: The crowd suddenly grew quiet.
trans: 人群顿时安静了下来。

name: The drunk, however, seemed quite sure of himself.
trans: 然而，醉汉似乎对自己很有信心。

name: When the bull got close to him, he clumsily stepped aside to let it pass.
trans: 当公牛靠近时，他笨拙地躲到一边，让公牛从自己身边经过。

name: The crowd broke into cheers and the drunk bowed.
trans: 人群爆发出欢呼声，醉汉也鞠了一躬。

name: By this time, however three men had come into the ring and they quickly dragged the drunk to safety.
trans: 这时，已经有三个人走进了斗牛场，他们迅速把醉汉拖到了安全的地方。

name: Even the bull seemed to feel sorry for him,
trans: 就连那头公牛似乎也对他感到同情。

name: for it looked on sympathetically until the drunk was out of the way before once more turning its attention to the matador.
trans: 它一直以同情的眼神注视着那个醉汉，直到他离开现场后，才再次将注意力转向斗牛士。

name: Has Big Ben ever gone wrong?
trans: 大本钟曾经出过故障吗？

name: When you visit London, one of the first things you will see is Big Ben,
trans: 当你游览伦敦时，首先会看到的大概就是大本钟（Big Ben）了。

name: the famous clock which can be heard all over the world on the B.B.C.
trans: 那座著名的钟楼，它的钟声可以通过英国广播公司（BBC）的广播传遍全世界。

name: If the Houses of Parliament had not been burned down in 1834,
trans: 如果英国议会大厦没有在1834年被烧毁的话……

name: the great clock would never have been erected.
trans: 那座宏伟的钟楼根本不可能被建造起来。

name: Big Ben takes its name from Sir Benjamin Hall who was responsible for the making of the clock when the new Houses of Parliament were being built.
trans: 大本钟的名字来源于本杰明·霍尔爵士（Sir Benjamin Hall）——他在英国新议会大厦建造期间负责这座钟的制造工作。

name: It is not only of immense size, but is extremely accurate as well.
trans: 它不仅体积庞大，而且精度极高。

name: Officials from Greenwich Observatory have the clock checked twice a day.
trans: 格林尼治天文台的工作人员每天会校准这台时钟两次。

name: On the B.B.C. you can hear the clock when it is actually striking because microphones are connected to the clock tower.
trans: 在BBC的广播中，你可以听到钟声的实际敲击声——因为麦克风是直接连接到钟楼的。

name: Big Ben has rarely gone wrong.
trans: 大本钟几乎从未出过故障。

name: Once, however, it failed to give the correct time.
trans: 然而，有一次它没能准确地显示时间。

name: A painter who had been working on the tower hung a pot of paint on one of the hands and slowed it down!
trans: 一位一直在塔上工作的画家，把一罐颜料挂在塔的某个结构部件上，然后让塔的旋转速度变慢了！

name: What mistake was made?
trans: 到底犯了什么错误？

name: The great racing driver, Sir Malcolm Campbell, was the first man to drive at over 300 miles per hour.
trans: 伟大的赛车手马尔科姆·坎贝尔爵士（Sir Malcolm Campbell）是第一个驾驶汽车时速超过300英里的人。

name: He set up a new world record in September 1935 at Bonneville Salt Flats, Utah.
trans: 他在1935年9月于犹他州的博纳维尔盐滩（Bonneville Salt Flats）创造了新的世界纪录。

name: Bluebird, the car he was driving, had been specially built for him.
trans: 他驾驶的那辆名为“Bluebird”的汽车，是专门为他定制制造的。

name: It was over 30 feet in length and had a 2, 500-horsepower engine.
trans: 它的长度超过了30英尺（约9米），配备了一台功率为2500马力的发动机。

name: Although Campbell reached a speed of over 304 miles per hour,
trans: 尽管坎贝尔的速度超过了每小时304英里，

name: he had great difficulty in controlling the car because a tyre burst during the first run.
trans: 他在驾驶汽车时遇到了很大的困难，因为汽车在第一次行驶过程中就爆了一个轮胎。

name: After his attempt, Campbell was disappointed to learn that his average speed had been 299 miles per hour.
trans: 尝试之后，坎贝尔得知自己的平均速度仅为每小时299英里，这让他感到非常失望。

name: However, a few days later, he was told that a mistake had been made.
trans: 然而，几天后他被告知，原来出现了一个错误。

name: His average speed had been 301 miles per hour.
trans: 他的平均速度是每小时301英里。

name: Since that time, racing drivers have reached speeds over 600 miles an hour.
trans: 从那时起，赛车手的行驶速度已经超过了每小时600英里。

name: Following in his father's footsteps many years later, Sir Malcolm's son, Donald, also set up a world record.
trans: 许多年后，唐纳德继承了他父亲的脚步，也创造了一项世界纪录。

name: Like his father, he was driving a car called Bluebird.
trans: 和他父亲一样，他驾驶着一辆名叫“Bluebird”的汽车。

name: Did the boy go where he wanted to?
trans: 那个男孩去他想去的地方了吗？

name: Children who play truant from school are unimaginative.
trans: 那些逃学玩耍的孩子缺乏想象力。

name: A quiet days' fishing,
trans: 一个宁静的日子，用来钓鱼……

name: or eight hours in a cinema seeing the same film over and over again, is usually as far as they get.
trans: 或者，他们最多也就会在电影院里待上八个小时，一遍又一遍地看同一部电影而已。

name: They have all been put to shame by a boy who, while playing truant travelled 1, 600 miles.
trans: 他们都被一个男孩给比下去了；这个男孩虽然逃学了，却还是跋涉了1,600英里（约2,560公里）去旅行。

name: He hitchhiked to Dover and towards evening went into a boat to find somewhere to sleep.
trans: 他搭便车去了多佛，到了傍晚时分便乘船前往某个地方过夜。

name: When he woke up next morning, he discovered that the boat had, in the meantime, travelled to Calais.
trans: 第二天早上他醒来时，发现船已经驶到了加来。

name: No one noticed the boy as he crept off.
trans: 没有人注意到那个男孩悄悄地离开了。

name: From there, he hitchhiked to Paris in a lorry.
trans: 从那里开始，他搭便车（通过卡车）前往巴黎。

name: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
trans: 司机给了他几块饼干和一杯咖啡，然后把他留在了城外。

name: The next car the boy stopped did not take him into the centre of Paris as he hoped it would,
trans: 男孩接下来拦下的那辆车并没有像他希望的那样带他前往巴黎市中心。

name: but to Perpignan on the French-Spanish border.
trans: 而是前往位于法西边境的佩皮尼昂（Perpignan）。

name: There he was picked up by a policeman and sent back to England by the local authorities.
trans: 他被一名警察带走，随后由当地政府送回了英格兰。

name: He has surely set up a record for the thousands of children who dream of evading school.
trans: 他无疑为那些梦想逃学的小孩树立了一个“榜样”——他们的行为都因此被记录在案了。

name: Why was their disguise 'too perfect' ?
trans: 为什么他们的伪装“过于完美”呢？

name: An ancient bus stopped by a dry river bed and a party of famous actors and actresses got off.
trans: 一辆古老的公交车停在了干涸的河床旁，一群著名的演员从车上走了下来。

name: Dressed in dark glasses and old clothes,
trans: 他戴着墨镜，穿着旧衣服。

name: they had taken special precautions so that no one should recognize them.
trans: 他们采取了特别的预防措施，以确保没有人能够认出他们来。

name: But as they soon discovered, disguises can sometimes be too perfect.
trans: 但他们很快发现，伪装有时候会过于完美（即伪装得过于逼真，反而容易暴露真相）。

name: 'This is a wonderful place for a picnic,' said Gloria Gleam.
trans: “这是一个非常适合野餐的好地方，”格洛丽亚·格莱姆说道。

name: 'It couldn't be better, Gloria,' Brinksley Meers agreed.
trans: “再好不过了，格洛丽亚，”布林克斯利·米尔斯同意道。

name: 'No newspaper men, no film fans! Why don't we come more often?'
trans: “没有记者，也没有电影迷……我们为什么不多来几次呢？”

name: Meanwhile, two other actors Rockwall Slinger and Merlin Greeves,
trans: 与此同时，另外两位演员——Rockwall Slinger 和 Merlin Greeves——

name: had carried two large food baskets to a shady spot under some trees.
trans: 她把两个装满食物的大篮子搬到了树荫下的一处阴凉处。

name: When they had all made themselves comfortable, a stranger appeared.
trans: 当他们都安顿好自己后，一个陌生人出现了。

name: He looked very angry.
trans: 他看起来非常生气。

name: 'Now you get out of here, all of you!' he shouted.
trans: “现在，你们所有人都给我滚出去！”他大声喊道。

name: 'I'm sheriff here. Do you see that notice? It says "No Camping"  -- in case you can't read!'
trans: “我是这里的警长。你们看到那个告示了吗？上面写着‘禁止露营’——以防你们看不清楚！”

name: 'Look, sheriff,' said Rockwall,
trans: “听着，警长，”罗克沃尔说道，

name: 'don't be too hard on us. I'm Rockwall Slinger and this is Merlin Greeves.'
trans: “别对我们太苛刻了。我是 Rockwall Slinger，这位是 Merlin Greeves。”

name: 'Oh, is it?' said the sheriff with a sneer.
trans: “哦，是吗？”警长冷笑着说。

name: 'Well, I'm Brinksley Meers, and my other name is Gloria Gleam. Now you get out of here fast!'
trans: “好吧，我叫布林克斯利·米尔斯，我的另一个名字是格洛丽亚·格莱姆。现在，你赶紧离开这里！”

name: How did the woman get help?
trans: 这个女人是如何得到帮助的？

name: When a light passenger plane flew off course some time ago,
trans: 不久前，一架轻型客机偏离了预定航线。

name: it crashed in the mountains and its pilot was killed.
trans: 飞机在山区坠毁，飞行员不幸遇难。

name: The only passengers, a young woman and her two baby daughters, were unhurt.
trans: 唯一的乘客是一位年轻女子和她的两个女儿，她们都没有受伤。

name: It was the middle of winter.
trans: 那是冬天的中期。

name: Snow lay thick on the ground.
trans: 地上积满了厚厚的雪。

name: The woman knew that the nearest village was miles away.
trans: 那个女人知道，最近的村庄离这里有好几英里远。

name: When it grew dark, she turned a suitcase into a bed and put the children inside it,
trans: 天黑后，她把一个行李箱改成了“床”，然后把孩子们放了进去。

name: covering them with all the clothes she could find.
trans: 她用所有能找到的衣服把他们盖住了。

name: During the night, it got terribly cold.
trans: 到了晚上，天气变得非常寒冷。

name: The woman kept as near as she could to the children and even tried to get into the case herself, but it was too small.
trans: 那个女人尽可能地靠近孩子们，甚至还试图自己钻进那个箱子里，但箱子太小了，她根本钻不进去。

name: Early next morning,
trans: 第二天清晨，

name: she heard planes passing overhead and wondered how she could send a signal.
trans: 她听到飞机从头顶飞过，思考着该如何发出求救信号。

name: Then she had an idea. She stamped out the letters 'SOS' in the snow.
trans: 突然，她想到了一个办法：她在雪地上用脚踩出了“SOS”三个字母。

name: Fortunately, a pilot saw the signal and sent a message by radio to the nearest town.
trans: 幸运的是，一名飞行员看到了这个求救信号，并通过无线电向最近的城镇发送了消息。

name: It was not long before a helicopter arrived on the scene to rescue the survivors of the plane crash.
trans: 不久之后，一架直升机赶到现场，救出了飞机失事中的幸存者。

name: What was the joke?
trans: 那个笑话是什么？

name: 'To end our special news bulletin,'
trans: “作为我们特别新闻播报的结束，”

name: said the voice of the television announcer, 'we're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
trans: 电视播音员的声音说道：“我们现在正前往卡拉布里亚地区的通心粉种植区。”

name: Macaroni has been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
trans: 在这个地区，人们种植通心粉已经有六百多年的历史了。

name: Two of the leading growers Giuseppe Moldova and Riccardo Brabante,
trans: 两位领先的种植者——朱塞佩·莫尔多瓦（Giuseppe Moldova）和里卡多·布拉班特（Riccardo Brabante）

name: tell me that they have been expecting a splendid crop this year and harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
trans: 告诉我，他们原本预计今年会有丰收，因此收割工作也比往年提前开始了。

name: Here you can see two workers who, between them,
trans: 在这里，你可以看到两名工人；他们两人共同完成了某项工作。

name: have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
trans: 我刚刚完成了切割三车装的金棕色通心粉茎的工作。

name: The whole village has been working day and night gathering and threshing this year's crop before the September rains.
trans: 整个村庄的村民们都在夜以继日地工作，忙着收割和脱粒今年的庄稼，以便在九月的雨季来临之前完成所有工作。

name: On the right, you can see Mrs. Brabante herself.
trans: 在右边，你可以看到布拉班特夫人本人。

name: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
trans: 她已经帮助她的丈夫三十年了。

name: Mrs. Brabante is talking to the manager of the local factory where the crop is processed.
trans: 布拉班特夫人正在与当地工厂的经理交谈，这家工厂负责加工这些农作物。

name: This last scene shows you what will happen at the end of the harvest:
trans: 这最后一个场景展示了收获结束时将会发生的事情：

name: the famous Calabrian macaroni-eating competition!
trans: 那就是著名的卡拉布里亚地区“吃通心粉比赛”！

name: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, has won it every year since 1991.
trans: 现任冠军弗拉泰利先生（Signor Fratelli）自1991年以来每年都赢得了这场比赛。

name: And that ends our special bulletin for today, Thursday, April 1st.
trans: 今天的特别报道到此结束，现在是4月1日，星期四。

name: We're now going back to the studio.'
trans: 我们现在将回到演播室。

name: Did the doctors find out how the woman died?
trans: 医生们查明这名妇女的死因了吗？

name: The mummy of an Egyptian woman who died in 800 B.C. has just had an operation.
trans: 这位埃及女性的木乃伊（她死于公元前800年）刚刚接受了一次手术。

name: The mummy is that of Shepenmut who was once a singer in the Temple of Thebes.
trans: 这具木乃伊属于谢彭穆特（Shepenmut），她曾经是底比斯神庙中的一名歌手。

name: As there were strange marks on the X-ray plates taken of the mummy,
trans: 由于在拍摄木乃伊的X光片上发现了奇怪的痕迹，

name: doctors have been trying to find out whether the woman died of a rare disease.
trans: 医生们一直在试图确定这名女性是否死于一种罕见的疾病。

name: The only way to do this was to operate.
trans: 唯一可行的办法就是立即采取行动（或：开始执行这项任务）。

name: The operation, which lasted for over four hours,
trans: 这次手术持续了四个多小时。

name: proved to be very difficult because of the hard resin which covered the skin.
trans: 由于皮肤上覆盖着一层坚硬的树脂，这被证明是非常困难的（即：处理这个问题的过程非常复杂或具有挑战性）。

name: The doctors removed a section of the mummy and sent it to a laboratory.
trans: 医生们切下了木乃伊的一部分组织，并将其送到了实验室进行检测。

name: They also found something which the X-ray plates did not show: a small wax figure of the god Duamutef.
trans: 他们还发现了一些X光片未能显示的东西：一个微小的、用蜡制成的杜阿穆特夫神像。

name: This god which has the head of a cow was normally placed inside a mummy.
trans: 这个长着牛头的神像通常被放置在木乃伊的体内。

name: The doctors have not yet decided how the woman died.
trans: 医生们尚未确定这名妇女的死因。

name: They feared that the mummy would fall to pieces when they cut it open,
trans: 他们担心在打开木乃伊时，木乃伊会碎成碎片。

name: but fortunately this has not happened.
trans: 但幸运的是，这种情况并没有发生。

name: The mummy successfully survived the operation.
trans: 这具木乃伊成功度过了手术。

name: For how long did the writer give up smoking?
trans: 作者戒烟持续了多久？

name: After reading an article entitled 'Cigarette Smoking and Your Health' I lit a cigarette to calm my nerves.
trans: 在读完一篇题为《吸烟与健康》的文章后，我点燃了一支烟来缓解自己的紧张情绪。

name: I smoked with concentration and pleasure as I was sure that this would be my last cigarette.
trans: 我专注而愉悦地抽着这支烟，因为我知道这将是我的最后一支烟了。

name: For a whole week I did not smoke at all and during this time my wife suffered terribly.
trans: 整整一个星期里，我都没有抽烟；而在这期间，我的妻子却承受了极大的痛苦。

name: I had all the usual symptoms of someone giving up smoking: a bad temper and an enormous appetite.
trans: 我出现了所有典型的戒烟后症状：脾气变得暴躁，食欲变得异常旺盛。

name: My friends kept on offering me cigarettes and cigars.
trans: 我的朋友们一直不停地给我提供香烟和雪茄。

name: They made no effort to hide their amusement whenever I produced a packet of sweets from my pocket.
trans: 每当我从口袋里掏出一包糖果时，他们总是毫不掩饰自己的开心和兴奋。

name: After seven days of this I went to a party.
trans: 经过七天的这种状态后，我参加了一个派对。

name: Everybody around me was smoking and I felt extremely uncomfortable.
trans: 我周围的每个人都在抽烟，这让我感到非常不舒服。

name: When my old friend Brian urged me to accept a cigarette, it was more than I could bear.
trans: 当我的老朋友布莱恩坚持要我抽一支烟时，我真的再也无法忍受了。

name: I took one guiltily, lit it and smoked with satisfaction.
trans: 我带着一丝内疚感拿了一支烟，点燃它后，心满意足地抽了起来。

name: My wife was delighted that things had returned to normal once more.
trans: 我的妻子很高兴，因为一切终于恢复了正常。

name: Anyway, as Brian pointed out, it is the easiest thing in the world to give up smoking.
trans: 无论如何，正如布莱恩指出的那样，戒烟其实是一件非常容易的事情。

name: He himself has done it lots of times!
trans: 他自己也做过很多次了！

name: Why did the plane turn back?
trans: 为什么飞机又折返了呢？

name: I used to travel by air a great deal when I was a boy.
trans: 我小时候经常坐飞机旅行。

name: My parents used to live in South America and I used to fly there from Europe in the holidays.
trans: 我的父母以前住在南美洲，每逢假期我都会从欧洲飞往那里去看他们。

name: A flight attendant would take charge of me and I never had an unpleasant experience.
trans: 每次都有空乘人员来照顾我，而我从未有过任何不愉快的经历。

name: I am used to travelling by air and only on one occasion have I ever felt frightened.
trans: 我习惯乘坐飞机出行，只有一次感到过害怕。

name: After taking off, we were flying low over the city and slowly gaining height,
trans: 起飞后，我们低空飞过城市，然后逐渐开始上升。

name: when the plane suddenly turned round and flew back to the airport.
trans: 当飞机突然掉头，飞回机场时……

name: While we were waiting to land, a flight attendant told us to keep calm
trans: 在我们等待降落的期间，一位空乘人员让我们保持冷静。

name: and to get off the plane quietly as soon as it had touched down.
trans: 并且要在飞机一降落就立刻悄悄地离开飞机。

name: Everybody on board was worried and we were curious to find out what had happened.
trans: 船上的每个人都非常担心，我们都很好奇到底发生了什么事。

name: Later we learnt that there was a very important person on board.
trans: 后来我们得知，船上有一位非常重要的人物。

name: The police had been told that a bomb had been planted on the plane.
trans: 警方接到消息称，飞机上被安置了一枚炸弹。

name: After we had landed, the plane was searched thoroughly.
trans: 我们降落之后，飞机被彻底搜查了一遍。

name: Fortunately, nothing was found and five hours later we were able to take off again.
trans: 幸运的是，什么问题都没有被发现；五小时后，我们终于能够再次起飞了。

name: How many people visited the Great Exhibition of 1851?
trans: 有多少人参观了1851年的万国博览会？

name: Perhaps the most extraordinary building of the 19th century was the Crystal Palace
trans: 也许19世纪最非凡的建筑当属水晶宫（Crystal Palace）了。

name: which was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
trans: 这座建筑是为1851年的万国博览会而在海德公园建造的。

name: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings in the world, for it was made of iron and glass.
trans: 水晶宫与世界上所有的其他建筑都不同，因为它是由铁和玻璃建造的。

name: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time and a lot of people from many countries came to see it.
trans: 这是有史以来最大的建筑之一，许多来自不同国家的人都前来参观它。

name: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world.
trans: 大量商品从世界各地被运送到这次展览上。

name: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
trans: 展会上还展示了许多机械设备。

name: The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer.
trans: 展会上最令人惊叹的机械设备是纳斯米思（Nasmyth）制造的蒸汽锤。

name: Though in those days travelling was not as easy as it is today,
trans: 尽管在那个时候旅行并不像现在这样方便，

name: steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
trans: 蒸汽船将成千上万的游客从欧洲运送到英吉利海峡对岸。

name: On arriving in England, they were, taken to the Crystal Palace by train.
trans: 抵达英格兰后，他们乘火车被送往水晶宫（Crystal Palace）。

name: There were six million visitors in all,
trans: 总共有六百万名游客。

name: and the profits from the exhibition were used to build museums and colleges.
trans: 展览的收入被用来建设博物馆和学院。

name: Later, the Crystal Palace was moved to South London.
trans: 后来，水晶宫队搬到了伦敦南部。

name: It remained one of the most famous buildings in the world until it was burnt down in 1936.
trans: 它一直是世界上最著名的建筑之一，直到 1936 年被烧毁。

name: Why did the prisoner attack the driver?
trans: 为什么囚犯会攻击司机？

name: When he had killed the guard, the prisoner of war quickly dragged him into the bushes.
trans: 当他杀死了那个卫兵后，这名战俘立刻把他拖进了灌木丛中。

name: Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
trans: 他在黑暗中迅速行动，很快就换上了那具死者的衣服。

name: Now, dressed in a blue uniform and with a rifle over his shoulder,
trans: 现在，他穿着蓝色制服，肩上扛着一把步枪。

name: the prisoner marched boldly up and down in front of the camp.
trans: 囚犯在营地前大胆地来回走动（或：来回踱步）。

name: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
trans: 他能听到营地里传来的喊叫声。

name: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there: they had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
trans: 灯光亮如白昼，人们四处奔忙——他们刚刚发现有一名囚犯逃走了。

name: At that moment, a large black car with four officers inside it, stopped at the camp gates.
trans: 就在那一刻，一辆载有四名警官的黑色轿车停在了营地的门口。

name: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
trans: 军官们走出来后，囚犯立刻立正并敬礼，以示尊敬。

name: When they had gone the driver of the car came towards him.
trans: 当他们离开后，那辆车的司机朝他走了过来。

name: The man obviously wanted to talk.
trans: 显然，这个人想说话。

name: He was rather elderly with grey hair and clear blue eyes.
trans: 他年纪较大，头发已经花白，眼睛则是清澈的蓝色。

name: The prisoner felt sorry for him, but there was nothing else he could do.
trans: 囚犯对他感到同情，但他无能为力。

name: As the man came near the prisoner knocked him to the ground with a sharp blow.
trans: 当那个人靠近时，囚犯用一记猛烈的打击将他打倒在地。

name: Then, jumping into the car, he drove off as quickly as he could.
trans: 随后，那人跳进车里，以最快的速度开车离开了。

name: What was the monster called?
trans: 那条怪物叫什么名字？

name: Fishermen and sailors sometimes claim to have seen monsters in the sea.
trans: 渔民和水手们有时声称在海上看到了怪物。

name: Though people have often laughed at stories told by seamen,
trans: 虽然人们常常嘲笑水手们讲述的故事，

name: it is now known that many of these 'monsters' which have at times been sighted are simply strange fish.
trans: 但现在人们知道，许多被目击的“怪物”其实只是奇怪的鱼类而已。

name: Occasionally, unusual creatures are washed to the shore, but they are rarely caught out at sea.
trans: 偶尔，一些不寻常的生物会被冲上岸，但在海上捕捉到它们的情况非常罕见。

name: Some time ago, however, a peculiar fish was caught near Madagascar.
trans: 然而，不久前，在马达加斯加附近确实捕获了一条奇特的鱼。

name: A small fishing boat was carried miles out to sea by the powerful fish as it pulled on the line.
trans: 一条小渔船被这条强大的鱼拖到了几英里外的海里。

name: Realizing that this was no ordinary fish, the fisherman made every effort not to damage it in any way.
trans: 意识到这绝不是一条普通的鱼，渔民竭尽全力避免对其造成任何伤害。

name: When it was eventually brought to shore, it was found to be over thirteen feet long.
trans: 当这条鱼最终被带到岸上时，人们发现它的长度超过了十三英尺。

name: It had a head like a horse big blue eyes, shining silver skin, and a bright red tail.
trans: 它有着马一样的头部、大大的蓝色眼睛、闪亮的银色皮肤以及鲜红色的尾巴。

name: The fish, which has since been set to a museum where it is being examined by a scientist, is called an oarfish.
trans: 这条鱼现在被保存在博物馆里，由科学家们进行研究。它的名字叫做“桨鱼”。

name: Such creatures have rarely been seen alive by man as they live at a depth of six hundred feet.
trans: 由于这种生物生活在六百英尺深的海域，人类很少有机会亲眼见到它们的活体。

name: Why did Patrick keep on asking the same question?
trans: 为什么帕特里克一直重复同一个问题？

name: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.
trans: 前首相温特沃斯·莱恩先生在最近的选举中落败了。

name: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.
trans: 他现在退出了政坛，搬去了国外。

name: My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's Radical Progressive Party.
trans: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是莱恩先生领导的激进进步党的强烈反对者。

name: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
trans: 选举结束后，帕特里克去了前首相的住所。

name: When he asked if Mr. Lane lived there, the policeman on duty told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
trans: 当他询问莱恩先生是否还住在那里时，值班的警察告诉他，由于落败，前首相已经出国了。

name: On the following day Patrick went to the house again.
trans: 第二天，帕特里克再次来到那栋房子前。

name: The same policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance, when Patrick asked the same question.
trans: 还是那位警察，他正缓缓地从门口走过，帕特里克又问了同样的问题。

name: Though a little suspicious this time the policeman gave him the same answer.
trans: 虽然这次警察有些怀疑，但他还是给出了同样的回答。

name: The day after, Patrick went to the house once more and asked exactly the same question.
trans: 第三天，帕特里克再次来到那里，问了完全相同的问题。

name: This time, the policeman lost his temper.
trans: 这一次，警察终于失去了耐心。

name: 'I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday,' he shouted,
trans: “我昨天和前天都告诉过你！”他大声说道。

name: 'Mr.Lane was defeated in the elections.
trans: 莱恩先生在选举中落败了。

name: He has retired from political life and gone to live abroad!'
trans: 他已经退出了政坛，现在住在国外！

name: 'I know,' answered Patrick,' but I love to hear you say it!'
trans: “我知道，”帕特里克回答道，“但我真的很喜欢听到你这么说！”

name: Who will be driving the buses next week?
trans: 下周谁来负责驾驶这些公交车呢？

name: Busmen have decided to go on strike next week.
trans: 公交司机们已经决定下周举行罢工。

name: The strike is due to begin on Tuesday.
trans: 罢工定于周二开始。

name: No one knows how long it will last.
trans: 没有人知道这种情况会持续多久。

name: The busmen have stated that the strike will continue until general agreement is reached about pay and working conditions.
trans: 公交司机们表示，罢工将持续进行，直到就工资和工作条件达成全面共识为止。

name: Most people believe that the strike will last for at least a week.
trans: 大多数人认为这次罢工至少会持续一周。

name: Many owners of private cars are going to offer 'free rides' to people on their way to work.
trans: 许多私家车的车主打算为那些正在上班途中的人提供“免费搭车”的服务。

name: This will relieve pressure on the trains to some extent.
trans: 这将在一定程度上缓解火车的运行压力。

name: Meanwhile, a number of university students have volunteered to drive buses while the strike lasts.
trans: 与此同时，在罢工期间，许多大学生自愿担任公交车的司机。

name: All the students are expert drivers,
trans: 所有的学生都是驾驶技术高超的驾驶员。

name: but before they drive any of the buses, they will have to pass a special test.
trans: 但在他们驾驶任何一辆公交车之前，都必须通过一项特殊的测试。

name: The students are going to take the test in two days' time.
trans: 学生们将在两天后参加考试。

name: Even so, people are going to find it difficult to get to work.
trans: 即便如此，人们仍然会发现上班变得很困难。

name: But so far, the public has expressed its gratitude to the students in lettters to the Press.
trans: 不过到目前为止，公众已经通过写信给媒体来表达对学生的感激之情。

name: Only one or two people have objected that the students will drive too fast!
trans: 只有寥寥一两个人提出反对意见，认为学生们开车时可能会太快！

name: How long has Mr. Page been teaching?
trans: 佩奇先生教书已经有多久了？
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: I have just received a letter from my old school, informing me that my former headmaster, Mr. Stuart Page, will be retiring next week.
trans: 我刚刚收到我母校寄来的一封信，信中告诉我，我的前任校长斯图尔特·佩奇先生将于下周退休。
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: Pupils of the school old and new, will be sending him a present to mark the occasion.
trans: 无论是学校的老同学还是新同学，都会送他一份礼物来庆祝这个特殊的日子。
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: All those who have contributed towards the gift will sign their names in a large album which will be sent to the headmaster's home.
trans: 所有为这份礼物出过力的人都会在一张大相册上签名，然后这张相册会被寄到校长的家中。
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: We shall all remember Mr. Page for his patience and understanding and for the kindly encouragement he gave us when we went so unwillingly to school.
trans: 我们都会永远铭记佩奇先生——他总是充满耐心与理解，每当我们极不情愿地去上学时，他总会给予我们鼓励与支持。
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: A great many former pupils will be attending a farewell dinner in his honour next Thursday.
trans: 许多他的老同学将会参加下周四为他举办的告别晚宴。
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: It is a curious coincidence that the day before his retirement, Mr. Page will have been teaching for a total of forty years.
trans: 一个奇怪的巧合是：在佩奇先生退休的前一天，他的教学生涯将达到整整四十年。
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: After he has retired he will devote himself to gardening.
trans: 退休后，他将全身心投入到园艺活动中去。
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: For him, this will be an entirely new hobby.
trans: 对他来说，这将是一个全新的爱好。
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: But this does not matter, for, as he has often remarked, one is never too old to learn.
trans: 但这并不重要，因为正如他经常说的那样：人永远都不应该停止学习。
lesson: NCE2 · Never Too Old To Learn

name: What was the danger?
trans: 危险是什么？

name: As the man tried to swing the speedboat round, the steering wheel came away in his hands.
trans: 当那个男人试图转动快艇的方向时，方向盘突然从他手中脱落了。

name: He waved desperately to his companion, who had been water skiing for the last fifteen minutes.
trans: 他拼命地向他的同伴挥手，而他的同伴一直在水上滑水。

name: Both men had hardly had time to realize what was happening when they were thrown violently into the sea.
trans: 两人几乎还没来得及反应发生了什么，就被猛地抛进了海里。

name: The speedboat had struck a buoy, but it continued to move very quickly across the water.
trans: 快艇撞到了一个浮标上，但仍然以极快的速度继续在水面上行驶。

name: Both men had just begun to swim towards the shore,
trans: 两人刚刚开始朝岸边游去，

name: when they noticed with dismay that the speedboat was moving in a circle.
trans: 就惊恐地发现快艇正在绕着一个圈行驶。

name: It now came straight towards them at tremendous speed.
trans: 现在，快艇正以惊人的速度朝他们直冲过来。

name: In less than a minute, it roared past them only a few feet away.
trans: 不到一分钟的时间，它就从他们身边呼啸而过，距离他们只有几英尺远。

name: After it had passed, they swam on as quickly as they could because they knew that the boat would soon return.
trans: 快艇驶过后，他们拼命地继续游动，因为他们知道快艇很快就会再次回来。

name: They had just had enough time to swim out of danger when the boat again completed a circle.
trans: 他们刚好有足够的时间游到安全的地方，这时快艇又完成了一个圈的行驶。

name: On this occasion, however, it had slowed down considerably.
trans: 然而这一次，它的速度明显慢了很多。

name: The petrol had nearly all been used up.
trans: 汽油几乎已经用完了。

name: Before long, the noise dropped completely and the boat began to drift gently across the water.
trans: 不久之后，周围的噪音完全消失了，小船开始在水面上缓缓漂动。

name: What was wrong with the man's story?
trans: 这个男人的故事有什么问题吗？

name: 'At the time the murder was committed, I was travelling on the 8 o'clock train to London,' said the man.
trans: “谋杀案发生的时候，我正在乘坐早上8点的火车前往伦敦，”那名男子说道。

name: 'Do you always catch such an early train?' asked the inspector.
trans: “你总是这么早赶火车吗？”检查员问道。

name: 'Of course I do,' answered the man.
trans: “当然了，”那个男人回答道。

name: 'I must be at work at 10 o'clock.
trans: 我必须在10点钟去上班。

name: My employer will confirm that I was there on time.'
trans: 我的雇主会证实我确实准时到达了。

name: 'Would a later train get you to work on time?' asked the inspector.
trans: “晚一点的火车能让你准时到达工作地点吗？”检查员问道。

name: 'I suppose it would, but I never catch a later train.'
trans: “我想应该是这样的，但我从来都赶不上晚点的火车。”

name: 'At what time did you arrive at the station?'
trans: 你什么时候到达车站的？

name: 'At ten to eight. I bought a paper and waited for the train.'
trans: 八点十分的时候，我买了一张报纸，然后等待火车的到来。

name: 'And you didn't notice anything unusual?'
trans: “那你没有注意到任何异常的情况吗？”

name: 'Of course not.'
trans: “当然不会。”

name: 'I suggest,' said the inspector,' that you are not telling the truth.
trans: “我认为，”检查员说，“你并没有说实话。”

name: I suggest that you did not catch the 8 o'clock train,
trans: 我认为你可能没有赶上8点的火车。

name: but that you caught the 8.25 which would still get you to work on time.
trans: 不过你赶上了8点25分的班车，这样仍然可以准时到达工作地点。

name: You see, on the morning of the murder, the 8 o'clock train did not run at all.
trans: 你知道吗，在谋杀案发生的那个早晨，8点的火车根本就没有运行。

name: It broke down at Ferngreen station and was taken off the line.'
trans: 它在费恩格林车站发生了故障，随后被从铁路上撤下（即不再允许列车在该站停靠或通过）。

name: Why is the rescue taking so long?
trans: 为什么救援工作需要这么长时间？

name: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.
trans: 六名男子已在矿井中被困了十七个小时。

name: If they are not brought to the surface soon they may lose their lives.
trans: 如果他们不能尽快被救上来，他们可能会丧命。

name: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.
trans: 然而，救援工作却非常困难。

name: If explosives are used, vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.
trans: 如果使用了炸药，震动会导致矿井的屋顶坍塌。

name: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.
trans: 因此，救援人员正在矿井的北侧钻孔。

name: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
trans: 他们打算用一个特殊的太空舱将这些人员送回地球。

name: If there had not been a hard layer of rock beneath the soil,
trans: 如果土壤下面没有坚硬的岩层的话……

name: they would have completed the job in a few hours.
trans: 他们本可以在几个小时内完成这项工作。

name: As it is, they have been drilling for 16 hours and they still have a long way to go.
trans: 到目前为止，他们已经连续钻探了16个小时，但距离完成工作还有很长的路要走。

name: Meanwhile, a microphone, which was lowered into the mine two hours ago,
trans: 与此同时，两小时前被放入矿井中的那个麦克风……

name: has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
trans: 这使得这些男性能够与他们最亲近的亲人保持联系。

name: Though they are running out of food and drink,
trans: 尽管他们的食物和饮用水即将耗尽，

name: the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
trans: 这些人们依然保持着乐观和信心，相信自己很快就能获救。

name: They have been told that rescue operations are progressing smoothly.
trans: 他们被告知救援行动正在顺利推进。

name: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock, they would lose heart.
trans: 如果他们知道在坚硬的岩石中钻孔有多么困难，他们恐怕会失去信心。

name: Who made the only funny joke that evening and why?
trans: 谁在那个晚上讲了唯一一个有趣的笑话？为什么呢？
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: People will do anything to see a free show--even if it is a bad one.
trans: 人们会不惜一切代价去看一场免费的演出——哪怕这场演出很糟糕。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: When the news got round that a comedy show would be presented
trans: 当消息传开，说将有一档喜剧节目播出时……
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: at our local cinema by the P. and U. Bird Seed Company, we all rushed to see it.
trans: 在我们当地的电影院（该电影院由 P. and U. Bird Seed 公司运营），我们都纷纷赶去观看这部电影。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: We had to queue for hours to get in and there must have been several hundred people present just before the show began.
trans: 我们不得不排队等待数小时才能进入现场；在演出开始前，现场肯定有几百人。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: Unfortunately, the show was one of the dullest we have ever seen.
trans: 不幸的是，这部剧是我们看过的最无聊的剧集之一。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: Those who failed to get in need not have felt disappointed,
trans: 那些未能被录取的人不必感到失望。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: as many of the artistes who should have appeared did not come.
trans: 许多本应出席的艺术家都没有来。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: The only funny things we heard that evening came from the advertiser at the beginning of the programme.
trans: 那天晚上我们听到的唯一有趣的内容，来自节目开始时出现的那位广告商。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: He was obviously very nervous and for some minutes stood awkwardly before the microphone.
trans: 他显然非常紧张，在麦克风前尴尬地站了好几分钟。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: As soon as he opened his mouth, everyone burst out laughing.
trans: 他一开口，所有人立刻都笑了起来。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: We all know what the poor man should have said,
trans: 我们都知道那个穷人本应该说什么。
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: but what he actually said was: 'This is the Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company. Good ladies, evening and gentlemen!'
trans: 但他实际上说的是：“这是‘Poo and Ee Seed Bird Company’。女士们、先生们，晚上好！”
lesson: NCE2 · A Slip of the Tongue

name: What kind of fish are they?
trans: 这些鱼是什么种类的呢？

name: Fish and chips has always been a favourite dish in Britain,
trans: 炸鱼薯条一直是英国人喜爱的美食，

name: but as the oceans have been overfished, fish has become more and more expensive.
trans: 但由于海洋过度捕捞，鱼类的价格越来越高。

name: So it comes as a surprise to learn that giant fish are terrifying the divers on North Sea oil rigs.
trans: 因此，当人们得知巨大的鱼类正在让北海石油钻井平台的潜水员感到恐惧时，确实感到十分惊讶。

name: Oil rigs have to be repaired frequently and divers, who often have to work in darkness a hundred feet under water,
trans: 这些石油钻井平台需要频繁维修，而潜水员往往必须在百英尺深的水下工作；

name: have been frightened out of their wits by giant fish bumping into them as they work.
trans: 巨大的鱼类在潜水员作业时突然撞上他们，让他们惊恐万分。

name: Now they have had special cages made to protect them from these monsters.
trans: 现在，人们专门为潜水员制造了防护笼子来保护他们免受这些鱼类的伤害。

name: The fish are not sharks or killer whales,
trans: 这些鱼既不是鲨鱼，也不是虎鲸，

name: but favourite eating varieties like cod and skate which grow to unnatural sizes,
trans: 而是人们常吃的鳕鱼和鳐鱼等鱼类，它们长得异常巨大，

name: sometimes as much as twelve feet in length.
trans: 有些甚至长达十二英尺。

name: Three factors have caused these fish to grow so large:
trans: 导致这些鱼类体型如此庞大的原因有三个：

name: the warm water round the hot oil pipes under the sea;
trans: 首先是海底热油管道周围的温暖海水；

name: the plentiful supply of food thrown overboard by the crews on the rigs;
trans: 钻井平台上工作人员扔到海里的大量食物；

name: the total absence of fishing boats around the oil rigs.
trans: 油井周围完全没有渔船。

name: As a result, the fish just eat and eat and grow and grow in the lovely warm water.
trans: 因此，鱼儿在温暖的海水中不停地进食、生长。

name: Who eats who?
trans: 那么，最终是谁在捕食这些鱼呢？

name: Where was the station's Commanding Officer?
trans: 车站的指挥官在哪里？
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby.
trans: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球，它似乎正朝附近的一个英国皇家空军基地飞去。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
trans: 他立即通知了相关部门，然而那里没有人能够解开这个谜团。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news,
trans: 当控制塔里的官员听到这个消息时，他非常生气。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
trans: 因为气球对飞机来说可能构成很大的危险。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
trans: 他说可能有人在监视这个基地，因此飞行员被命令密切关注那个奇怪的物体。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
trans: 飞行员成功地让热气球在空中盘旋了一段时间。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: He could make out three men in a basket under it and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
trans: 他能够看到篮子下面有三个人，其中一个人正拿着一副双筒望远镜。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
trans: 当热气球飞到车站上空时，飞行员看到其中一个人正在拍照。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
trans: 不久之后，气球开始下降，并降落在了一个机场附近。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: The police were called in, but they could not arrest anyone,
trans: 警察被叫来了，但他们没能逮捕任何人。
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: for the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station!
trans: 因为那个篮子里装着两名国会议员以及该军事基地的指挥官！
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: As the Commanding Officer explained later, one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing!
trans: 正如指挥官后来解释的那样，该基地的一半人员根本不知道另一半在做什么！
lesson: NCE2 · Three Men in a Basket

name: Why did the policeman ask the writer to come to the police station?
trans: 为什么警察让那位作家去警察局呢？

name: It must have been about two in the morning when I returned home.
trans: 我回到家时，大概已经是凌晨两点左右了。

name: I tried to wake up my wife by ringing the doorbell,
trans: 我试着按门铃叫醒我的妻子，

name: but she was fast asleep,
trans: 但她睡得很熟，

name: so I got a ladder from the shed in the garden, put it against the wall,
trans: 于是我从花园里的棚屋里拿了一把梯子，把它靠在墙上，

name: and began climbing towards the bedroom window.
trans: 然后开始往卧室的窗户爬去。

name: I was almost there when a sarcastic voice below said.
trans: 我快爬到窗户的时候，下面传来一个讽刺的声音：

name: 'I don't think the windows need cleaning at this time of the night.'
trans: ‘我觉得这个时候窗户并不需要清洁。’

name: I looked down and nearly fell off the ladder when I saw a policeman.
trans: 我往下看，差点从梯子上掉下来，因为看到了一个警察。

name: I immediately regretted answering in the way I did, but I said, 'I enjoy cleaning windows at night.'
trans: 我立刻后悔自己之前的回答方式，但还是说：‘我喜欢在晚上清洁窗户。’

name: 'So do I,' answered the policeman in the same tone.
trans: ‘我也是，’警察用同样的语气回答道。

name: Excuse my interrupting you.
trans: 抱歉打扰你了。

name: I hate to interrupt a man when he's busy working, but would you mind coming with me to the station?'
trans: “我很不想在一个人忙于工作的时候打扰他，但你能陪我去车站吗？”

name: 'Well, I'd prefer to stay here,' I said.
trans: “嗯，我宁愿待在这里，”我说。

name: 'You see, I've forgotten my key.'
trans: “你知道的，我忘带钥匙了。”

name: 'Your what?' he called.
trans: “你的什么？”他喊道。

name: 'My key,' I shouted.
trans: “我的钥匙！”我大声回答。

name: Fortunately, the shouting woke up my wife who opened the window just as the policeman had started to climb towards me.
trans: 幸运的是，我的喊声吵醒了我的妻子，就在警察开始朝我走来的时候，她打开了窗户。

name: Where was the Statue of Liberty made?
trans: 自由女神像是在哪里制造的？

name: One of the most famous monuments in the world, the Statue of Liberty,
trans: 自由女神像是世界最著名的纪念碑之一。

name: was presented to the USA in the nineteenth century by the people of France.
trans: 这一事物是在十九世纪由法国人介绍给美国的。

name: The great statue, which was designed by the sculptor Auguste Bartholdi, took ten years to complete.
trans: 这座宏伟的雕像由雕塑家奥古斯特·巴托尔迪设计，耗时十年才完成。

name: The actual figure was made of copper supported by a metal framework which had been especially constructed by Eiffel.
trans: 这个实物是由铜制成的，其结构由一个金属框架支撑；这个金属框架是埃菲尔专门为这个作品设计的。

name: Before it could be transported to the United States,
trans: 在它被运往美国之前，

name: a site had to be found for it and a pedestal had to be built.
trans: 必须为它找一个合适的地点，并且还要为其搭建一个基座（或支撑结构）。

name: The site chosen was an island at the entrance of New York Harbour.
trans: 所选的位置是一座位于纽约港入口处的岛屿。

name: By 1884, a statue which was 151 feet tall had been erected in Paris.
trans: 到1884年，一座高151英尺的雕像已经在巴黎竖立起来了。

name: The following year, it was taken to pieces and sent to America.
trans: 第二年，它被拆解成零件，然后被运往了美国。

name: By the end of October 1886,
the statue had been put together again and it was officially presented to the American people by Bartholdi.
trans: 这座雕像已经被重新组装完成，并由巴托尔迪正式献给了美国人民。

name: Ever since then, the great monument has been a symbol of liberty
trans: 从那时起，这座宏伟的纪念碑就成为了自由的象征。

name: for the millions of people who have passed through New York Harbour to make their homes in America.
trans: 对于那些曾经穿越纽约港、最终在美国安家落户的数百万人来说……

name: What kind of race do the children compete in?
trans: 孩子们参加的是什么样的比赛呢？

name: Experiments have proved that children can be instructed in swimming at a very early age.
trans: 实验已经证明，儿童可以在非常年幼的时候就开始学习游泳。

name: At a special swimming pool in Los Angeles,
trans: 在洛杉矶的一个特殊游泳池里，

name: children become expert at holding their breath under water even before they can walk.
trans: 孩子们甚至在还不会走路的时候，就已经能够熟练地在水下屏住呼吸了。

name: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
trans: 两个月大的婴儿似乎并不抗拒进入水中。

name: It is not long before they are so accustomed to swimming that they can pick up weights from the floor of the pool.
trans: 没过多久，他们就习惯了游泳，甚至能够从泳池底部捡起重物了。

name: A game that is very popular with these young swimmers is the underwater tricycle race.
trans: 在这些年轻游泳运动员中非常受欢迎的一项游戏是水下三轮车比赛。

name: Tricycles are lined up on the floor of the pool seven feet under water.
trans: 三轮车被整齐地排列在水池底部——那里的水深达七英尺。

name: The children compete against each other to reach the other end of the pool.
trans: 孩子们互相竞争，看谁能第一个游到泳池的另一端。

name: Many pedal their tricycles but most of them prefer to push or drag them.
trans: 很多人骑着他们的三轮车，但大多数人更喜欢推着或拉着它们前进。

name: Some children can cover the whole length of the pool without coming up for breath even once.
trans: 有些孩子可以在游泳池里游完整个距离，而且一次都不需要停下来喘气。

name: Whether they will ever become future Olympic champions, only time will tell.
trans: 他们是否能够成为未来的奥运冠军，只有时间才能告诉我们。

name: Meanwhile, they should encourage those among us who cannot swim five yards before they are gasping for air.
trans: 与此同时，他们应该鼓励我们当中那些连五码都游不了、一游就会喘不过气来的人。

name: Why was the Ambassador particularly lucky?
trans: 为什么这位大使特别幸运呢？

name: When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.
trans: 当埃斯卡洛皮亚大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子感到非常震惊。

name: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
trans: 他看起来脸色苍白，衣服也破烂不堪。

name: 'What has happened?' she asked.
trans: “发生了什么事？”她问道。

name: 'How did your clothes get into such a mess?'
trans: “你的衣服怎么会弄得这么乱糟糟的？”

name: 'A fire extinguisher, my dear,' answered the Ambassador drily.
trans: “是一具灭火器，亲爱的，”大使冷淡地回答道。

name: 'University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.'
trans: 今天早上，一些大学生放火烧毁了大使馆。

name: 'Good heavens!' exclaimed his wife.
trans: “我的天啊！”他的妻子惊呼道。

name: 'And where were you at the time?'
trans: “那你当时在哪里？”

name: 'I was in my office as usual,' answered the Ambassador.
trans: “我像往常一样在办公室里，”大使回答道。

name: 'The fire broke out in the basement.
trans: 火灾发生在地下室。

name: I went down immediately, of course, and that fool, Horst,
trans: 我立刻就下去了，当然了；还有那个傻瓜，霍斯特……

name: aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
trans: 有人用灭火器朝我射来。

name: He thought I was on fire.
trans: 他以为我着火了。

name: I must definitely get that fellow posted.'
trans: 我一定要把那个人的信息发布出去。

name: The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions,
trans: 大使的妻子不停地提问。

name: when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
trans: 突然，她发现丈夫的帽子上有一个大洞。

name: 'And how can you explain that?' she asked.
trans: “那你又该如何解释这件事呢？”她问道。

name: 'Oh, that,' said the Ambassador.
trans: “哦，那个……”大使说道。

name: 'Someone fired a shot through my office window.
trans: 有人从我的办公室窗户向外开了一枪。

name: Accurate, don't you think?
trans: “非常准确，不是吗？”

name: Fortunately, I wasn't wearing it at the time.
trans: 幸运的是，当时我并没有戴着它。

name: If I had been, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.'
trans: 如果我当时在（某个地方），我就无法回家吃午饭了。

name: What happens to the lanterns at the end of the festival?
trans: 节庆结束时，那些灯笼会怎么样呢？

name: A Festival for the Dead is held once a year in Japan.
trans: 在日本，每年都会举行一次“亡灵节”（Festival for the Dead）。

name: This festival is a cheerful occasion,
trans: 这个节日是一个充满欢乐的场合。

name: for on this day, the dead are said to return to their homes and they are welcomed by the living.
trans: 因为据说在这一天，死者会回到他们的家中，而生者会迎接他们。

name: As they are expected to be hungry after their long journey, food is laid out for them.
trans: 由于他们在长途旅行后很可能会感到饥饿，所以已经为他们准备好了食物。

name: Specially-made lanterns are hung outside each house to help the dead to find their way.
trans: 每户人家的外面都挂有特制的灯笼，目的是帮助逝者在来世找到回家的路。

name: All night long, people dance and sing.
trans: 整晚，人们都在跳舞和唱歌。

name: In the early morning the food that had been laid out for the dead
trans: 清晨时分，那些原本为死者准备的食物……

name: is thrown into a river or into the sea as it is considered unlucky for anyone living to eat it.
trans: 这种动物会被扔进河流或海洋中，因为人们认为食用它的肉会给任何人带来厄运（即带来不幸）。

name: In towns that are near the sea, the tiny lanterns which had been hung in the streets the night before,
trans: 在那些靠近海边的小镇上，前一晚被挂在街上的那些小灯笼……

name: are placed into the water when the festival is over.
trans: 这些物品会在节日结束后被放入水中。

name: Thousands of lanterns slowly drift out to sea guiding the dead on their return journey to the other world.
trans: 成千上万的灯笼缓缓被放流入海，为逝者指引返回另一个世界的道路。

name: This is a moving spectacle, for crowds of people
trans: 这是一场令人感动的场面，成群的人们都聚集在一起观看。

name: stand on the shore watching the lanterns drifting away until they can be seen no more.
trans: 站在岸边，看着那些灯笼渐渐远去，直到它们完全消失在视线之外。
